descriptionByLocale.en:
Operations Support: Manufacturing Specialist, Operations Support, Large Scale Mammalian

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula for how we do it. Our greatest scientific solutions are dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for Operations Support and Manufacturing Specialists for our 6 x 20K Large Scale Mammalian Facility. In this role, you will be responsible for performing operational support activities within the Operations Support Team in partnership with Buffer Media Supply, USP, and DSP.

What you’ll do:

• Assignments within the Operations Support team focused on receipt and management of raw materials, single use materials, dispensing of small volume and large-scale medias and buffers to meet production demands and adherence to schedule.

• Processing of parts in washers and autoclaves

• Transport and storage of materials within temperature-controlled requirements

• Execution of tasks in compliance with safety regulations and cGMP quality requirements.

• Execution of production steps including interaction with HMIs and automated systems

Key responsibilities:

• Complete manufacturing activities in Operations Support area according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Recognition, interpretation, and elimination of deviations

• Review production documentation and work on deviations, change requests and implementation of CAPAs to ensure high-quality GMP standards

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

• Serve as deputy for Team Lead when needed

Key requirements:

• Fluent English with German language skills advantageous

• GMP operations experience a must

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or vocational training preferred

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician in a GMP environment is a plus

• Must be open to work in shift (2 or 3 shift system)

What we’re looking for:

• Motivated, self-starter with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset, ability to work independently, oversee the daily coordination of operational activities, and execute operations as part of team deliverables.

• Ideally, you have trained as an EFZ logistician / EFZ chemical and pharmaceutical technologist / EFZ laboratory technician specializing in chemistry or biology.

• Safety mindset; forklift and/or electric pallet truck training will be required

• Continuous improvement mindset with attention to detail and support of 6S standards

• Day shift schedule to start during training period and establishment of the Operations Support Department.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
Bioprocess Engineer (DSP)

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our manufacturing team where you will lead and optimize GMP production processes while contributing to impactful projects from tech transfer through clinical production. This role offers the opportunity to drive operational excellence and work at the forefront of biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

Site-based
This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

• Learn more: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Schedule, supervise, and document manufacturing activities in compliance with cGMP guidelines

• Act as a manufacturing expert within a multidisciplinary project team, supporting projects from tech transfer through clinical production

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality, cost, efficiency, and safety using operational excellence methodologies

• Represent the Lonza manufacturing unit during customer audits and site visits

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including QA, MSAT, and Engineering

• Support knowledge transfer, mentoring, and leadership within the production environment

• Ensure adherence to regulatory and quality standards in all production activities

What we are looking for

• Bachelor or Master’s or PhD degree in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Chemical Engineering, or a related field

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to guide teams in a GMP-regulated environment

• Experience in GMP manufacturing (preferred but not mandatory)

• Fluency in German and English

• Strong communication and collaboration skills across functions and stakeholders

• Continuous improvement mindset with focus on operational excellence

• Ability to work in complex, fast-paced project environments

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Buyer 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Drive value across indirect procurement categories by sourcing new suppliers, leading tenders, and negotiating impactful contracts that support seamless site operations.
Collaborate with regional and global procurement teams while managing CHF 35–60M spend, building strong supplier partnerships, and ensuring business continuity by aligning procurement strategies with evolving site needs. Check out your Career at Lonza!

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Partner with regional procurement and category management teams to implement sourcing strategies, deliver continuous improvement, and generate measurable value across indirect spend.

• Lead and support sourcing initiatives—tendering, negotiation, and contracting—while driving the adoption of innovative tools such as e-auctions and online catalogs.

• Collaborate with site stakeholders to ensure business continuity, align procurement with current and future needs, and provide accurate spend and savings forecasts.

• Manage supplier relationships end-to-end, fostering strong partnerships, monitoring performance, and driving innovation while ensuring compliance and mitigating supply risks.

• Optimize procurement efficiency by standardizing specifications, sharing best practices across sites, and identifying savings opportunities, risks, and synergies within a CHF 35–60M spend portfolio.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience in procurement with a strong focus on strategic sourcing, negotiation, and value creation beyond transactional tasks

• Demonstrated ability to think strategically, influencing and partnering with stakeholders across functions to drive impactful procurement outcomes

• Industry experience in pharma preferred with GMP knowledge considered a strong advantage

• Strong communication skills with fluency in English; German is a plus

• Familiarity with procurement tools and analytics (e.g., SAP Ariba, Power BI) and experience implementing category strategies is highly desirable

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Partner con i team regionali di approvvigionamento e gestione delle categorie per implementare strategie di approvvigionamento, fornire un miglioramento continuo e generare valore misurabile attraverso la spesa indiretta.
• Guidare e sostenere iniziative di sourcing, di gestione, di negoziazione e di contrazione, mentre guida l'adozione di strumenti innovativi come le e-auzioni e i cataloghi online.

• Ottimizzare l'efficienza degli appalti standardizzando le specifiche, la condivisione delle migliori pratiche tra i siti, l'individuazione delle opportunità di risparmio, dei rischi e delle sinergie all'interno di un portafoglio di spesa di CHF 35–60M. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Esperienza comprovata nell'approvvigionamento con una forte attenzione al sourcing strategico, alla negoziazione e alla creazione di valore oltre i compiti transazionali
• Dimostrata capacità di pensare strategicamente, influenzando e collaborando con le parti interessate attraverso le funzioni per guidare risultati di approvvigionamento
• Esperienza nel settore farmaceutico preferita con la conoscenza GMP considerato un forte vantaggio
• Forte capacità di comunicazione con fluenza in inglese; il tedesco è un plus
• La familiarità con gli strumenti di approvvigionamento e l'analisi (ad esempio, SAP Ariba, Power BI) e l'esperienza che implementa le strategie di categoria è altamente auspicabile Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

We are currently looking for a Senior QA Specialist (f/m/d) Process Validation for the expansion of our team here at our site in Visp. In this role, you will be QA responsible for the compliance of process validation with main focus on Small Molecules including validation activities at scale, continued process verification and Product Quality Reviews (PQRs).

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Ensure the manufacturing processes: APIs and Intermediates are in a validated state during their whole lifetime according to Lonza procedures, and in compliance with regulatory guidance

• Preparation of comprehensive process specific Validation Master Plans, describing the individual studies required for process validation

• Leading the process validation teams including communication with customers

• Preparation of the validation protocols and reports for the studies performed at manufacturing scale

• Assessment of changes and deviations during manufacturing for their impact on validation

• Preparation and maintenance of a documented continued process verification plan

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Chemistry or any related field

• Significant experience in the area of small molecules manufacturing, preferably in a validation function as well as strong background in cGMP

• Broad knowledge of manufacturing processes in GMP environment

• Experience in interacting with all kind of interfaces within the organization as well as with regulatory agencies (Swissmedic, FDA etc.)

• Fluency in English language is required; good German language skills are preferred

• Managing internal and external customer relations professionally and effectively

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

You will lead the development, qualification, validation, and implementation of automated and semi-automated inspection and container closure integrity testing processes, ensuring robust defect detection and product quality from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives in a pioneering environment, enjoys building processes from scratch with limited guidance, and wants to help shape the future of a growing Drug Product manufacturing site. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Support the production staff on the shopfloor by providing scientific expertise

• Support the GMP compliant qualification and validation activities of automated visual inspection system from an Operations perspective

• Prepare readiness for operative takeover of the automated, semi-automated, manual visual inspection and container closure integrity testing

• Accountable for safety, compliance and regulatory aspects. Preparation of risk analysis and all relevant procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and achieve business goals.

• Technical improvement execution: Execute improvements, Drive process related trouble shooting

• Leading/participate in change controls and deviations: using scientific and statistical knowledge to analyze data to provide process understanding, and to identify root causes of product and process failures.

• Represent the VI and CCIT during regulatory inspections and audits.

What we are looking for:

• Proven hands-on experience in pharmaceutical visual inspection for drug product in vials or syringes, in EITHER manual visual inspection, semi-automated, and/or fully automated visual inspection machines (AVI); experience across multiple inspection technologies is highly preferred.

• Knowledge of qualification of visual inspection machines, product validation and ideally with Container Closure Integrity Testing (CCIT) is preferred.

• Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment, building processes, standards, and solutions from the ground up with limited guidance and a strong continuous improvement mindset.

• Fluent in EITHER English OR German is required (fluency in both languages is an advantage)

• A relevant scientific or engineering degree is preferred, although equivalent technical training combined with substantial industry experience will also be considered.

Vous dirigerez le développement, la qualification, la validation et la mise en oeuvre de processus automatisés et semi-automatisés d'inspection et de contrôle de l'intégrité de la fermeture des contenants, assurant ainsi une détection robuste des défauts et la qualité du produit à partir du sol. C'est une occasion unique pour quelqu'un qui prospère dans un environnement pionnier, aime construire des processus à partir de zéro avec des conseils limités, et veut aider à façonner l'avenir d'un site de fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques en croissance. Découvrez votre carrière dans les services de médicaments à Lonza!
C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs.
La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices

Ce que vous ferez :

• Soutenir le personnel de production de l'atelier en fournissant une expertise scientifique

• Appuyer les activités de qualification et de validation conformes aux BPF du système automatisé d'inspection visuelle du point de vue des opérations

• Préparation à la reprise opérationnelle de l'inspection visuelle manuelle automatisée, semi-automatisée et des essais d'intégrité de la fermeture des conteneurs

• Responsable de la sécurité, de la conformité et des aspects réglementaires. Préparation d'une analyse des risques et de toutes les procédures pertinentes pour assurer la conformité à la réglementation et atteindre les objectifs opérationnels.

• Exécution d'amélioration technique: Améliorations d'exécution, Prise de trouble liée au processus d'entraînement

• Diriger/participer aux contrôles du changement et aux écarts : utiliser les connaissances scientifiques et statistiques pour analyser les données afin de comprendre les processus et d'identifier les causes profondes des échecs de produits et de procédés.

• Représenter le VI et le CCIT lors des inspections et des vérifications réglementaires.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Expérience éprouvée dans l'inspection visuelle du produit pharmaceutique en flacons ou en seringues, dans l'inspection visuelle manuelle EITHER, dans les machines d'inspection visuelle semi-automatisées et/ou entièrement automatisées (AVI); l'expérience dans plusieurs technologies d'inspection est hautement préférée.

• La connaissance de la qualification des machines d'inspection visuelle, de la validation des produits et, idéalement, des essais d'intégrité de fermeture des contenants (CCIT) est privilégiée.

• Capacité de travailler de façon autonome dans un environnement dynamique, de construire des processus, des normes et des solutions à partir de la base avec une orientation limitée et une forte amélioration continue de la mentalité.

• La maîtrise de l'anglais ou de l'allemand est requise (la maîtrise des deux langues est un avantage)

• Un diplôme scientifique ou technique pertinent est préféré, bien qu'une formation technique équivalente combinée à une expérience importante de l'industrie soit également envisagée.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician QC Microbiology (m/f/d) 60%
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp  wird ein/e Laborant/in der QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. Als Mitglied unseres jungen und dynamischen Mikrobiologie-Teams, bist du unter Einhaltung der GMP- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien verantwortliche für die Routine-Durchführung von verschiedenen mikrobiologischen Methoden.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Durchführung analytischer Methoden im Aufgabenbereich, Auswertung, Review und Berichten der Ergebnisse.

• Erstellen von Analysenprotokollen, Prüfanweisungen und Kurzberichten.

• Dokumentation aller Labortätigkeiten entsprechend GMP und internen Richtlinien.

• Einhaltung der Qualitäts- (SOP und GMP) und der Sicherheitsvorschriften.

• Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor.

• Methodischer Hauptfokus: Keim Identifizierungen und Endotoxin Messungen.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in, BTA, oder BSC mit Fachrichtung Biologie, Biochemie oder ähnlichem Bereich.

• Fliessend Deutsch und English von Vorteil.

• Hands-on Labor Erfahrung (insbesondere Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Analysetechniken) sind ein Plus.

• Kenntnisse im Bereich GMP ist ein Plus .

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Al sito di Visp, un assistente di laboratorio al QC Mikrobiologie è ricercato. Come membro del nostro team di microbiologia giovane e dinamica, sei responsabile per l'implementazione di routine di vari metodi microbiologici in conformità con GMP e linee guida di sicurezza.

I loro compiti:

• Attuazione dei metodi analitici nell'area di attività, valutazione, revisione e reporting dei risultati.

• Creare registri analitici, istruzioni di prova e brevi report.

• Documentazione di tutte le attività di laboratorio secondo GMP e linee guida interne.

• Rispetto della qualità (SOP e GMP) e delle norme di sicurezza.

• Pulizia e ordine in laboratorio.

• Focus metodologico principale: identificazione dei germi e misurazioni dell'endotossina.

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Formazione completa come assistente di laboratorio, BTA, o BSC specializzata in biologia, biochimica o campo simile.

• Flusso tedesco e inglese è benefico.

• L'esperienza di laboratorio Hands-on (specialmente l'esperienza con le tecniche di analisi microbiologiche) è un plus.

• La conoscenza di GMP è un vantaggio.

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a laboratory assistant at QC Mikrobiologie is sought. As a member of our young and dynamic microbiology team, you are responsible for the routine implementation of various microbiological methods in compliance with GMP and safety guidelines.

Their tasks:

• Implementation of analytical methods in the task area, evaluation, review and reporting of results.

• Create analytical logs, test instructions and short reports.

• Documentation of all laboratory activities according to GMP and internal guidelines.

• Compliance with quality (SOP and GMP) and safety regulations.

• Cleanliness and order in the laboratory.

• Main methodological focus: germ identifications and endotoxin measurements.

Your requirement profile:

• Completed training as a laboratory assistant, BTA, or BSC specialising in biology, biochemistry or similar field.

• Flowing German and English is beneficial.

• Hands-on laboratory experience (especially experience with microbiological analysis techniques) is a plus.

• Knowledge of GMP is a plus.

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a priority and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges and use their creativity to develop new ideas for complex problems. Together we make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This offers them the certainty and satisfaction of really making a difference with their own work.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Automation Technician DPS Growth Project 80-100% (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.it: Progetto di crescita del DPS tecnico di automazione 80-100% (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung: Verfügbar für berechtigte Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten sowie deren Familien.

Als Automation Technician (m/w/d) an unserem sterilen Produktionsstandort in Stein, Kanton Aargau, spielst du eine zentrale Rolle dabei, die Betriebsbereitschaft, Zuverlässigkeit und Compliance der HVAC‑ und Versorgungssysteme sicherzustellen, die die pharmazeutische Produktion unterstützen. In dieser Position trägst du zu sicheren, effizienten und regelkonformen Abläufen bei und stellst gleichzeitig hohe Standards in Qualität und technischer Exzellenz sicher.

Was auf Dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Dich zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits findest Du unten:

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Deine Aufgaben:

• Unterstützung von FATs und Inbetriebnahmen, um einen reibungslosen Übergang von aseptischen Fuellanlagen und automatisierten Systemen sicherzustellen

• Bereitstellung von First-Level-Support, Wartung und Troubleshooting für zugewiesene automatisierungsbezogene Systeme; enge Zusammenarbeit mit Mechanikteams zur Lösung technischer Probleme

• Durchführung und Dokumentation von Wartungs-, Kalibrierungs- und Inbetriebnahmearbeiten gemäss Sicherheits-, cGMP- und regulatorischen Anforderungen

• Überwachung und Steuerung automatisierter Produktions- und Anlagenprozesse zur Sicherstellung eines stabilen und zuverlässigen Betriebs

• Beitrag zu nachhaltigen Programmen und Tools, die die Anlagenbedienbarkeit, Systemzuverlässigkeit und langfristige Performance verbessern

• Vorbereitung von Systemen auf die Betriebsbereitschaft, inklusive Planung von Betriebsabläufen, Sicherstellung eines sicheren Systembetriebs, Verwaltung von Ersatzteilen und Werkzeugen sowie Organisation notwendiger Schulungen

• Schulung und Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender gemäss GxP- und Unternehmensrichtlinien

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung als Automation Technician EFZ oder gleichwertige Lehre im Bereich Automationsengineering

• Berufserfahrung in der Anlagenwartung, idealerweise in der Pharmaindustrie oder einem anderen stark regulierten Umfeld

• Kenntnisse in Siemens Step7, TIA Portal oder Emerson DeltaV sind von Vorteil

• Solide MS‑Office‑Kenntnisse (insbesondere Excel); SAP‑PM und CMX sind ein Plus

• Präzise, zuverlässige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit starkem technischem Verständnis und ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz

• Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Schichtbetrieb und Teilnahme am Pikettdienst

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind erwünscht

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

In qualità di tecnico di automazione (m/f/d) presso il nostro sito di produzione sterile a Stein, Canton Aargau, si gioca un ruolo centrale nel garantire la disponibilità operativa, l'affidabilità e la conformità dei sistemi di fornitura HVAC e che supportano la produzione farmaceutica. In questa posizione, contribuisce a processi sicuri, efficienti e conformi, garantendo elevati standard di qualità e di eccellenza tecnica.

Cosa ti aspetta:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. Trova la nostra lista completa dei vantaggi locali Di seguito:

• Vantaggi in pietra: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

I vostri compiti:

• Supporto per FAT e messa in servizio per garantire una transizione fluida dai sistemi di carburante asettici e dai sistemi automatizzati

• fornire supporto di primo livello, manutenzione e risoluzione dei problemi per i sistemi correlati all'automazione assegnati; Chiudere la collaborazione con i team meccanici per risolvere problemi tecnici

• Attuazione e documentazione dei lavori di manutenzione, taratura e messa in servizio secondo i requisiti di sicurezza, cGMP e normativa

• Monitoraggio e controllo dei processi automatizzati di produzione e impianti per garantire un funzionamento stabile e affidabile

• Contribuisci a programmi e strumenti sostenibili che migliorano l'usabilità degli asset, l'affidabilità del sistema e le prestazioni a lungo termine

• Preparazione di sistemi per la prontezza operativa, comprese le operazioni di pianificazione, assicurando il funzionamento sicuro del sistema, la gestione dei pezzi di ricambio e degli strumenti, e l'organizzazione della formazione necessaria

• Formazione e induzione di nuovi dipendenti in conformità con GxP e linee guida aziendali

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Formazione tecnica completa come Automation Technician EFZ o equivalente in ingegneria dell'automazione

• Esperienza professionale nella manutenzione degli impianti, idealmente nell'industria farmaceutica o in un altro ambiente altamente regolamentato

• Conoscenza di Siemens Step7, TIA Portal o Emerson DeltaV è un vantaggio

• Competenze Solid MS Office (in particolare Excel); SAP‐PM e CMX sono un plus

• Flusso di lavoro preciso, affidabile e strutturato con una forte comprensione tecnica e forti capacità di problem solving

• Volontà di lavorare ore flessibili, turni e partecipazione al servizio di piketting

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco; Le competenze in inglese sono desiderate

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

L'insegnamento dura tre anni. I meccanici di produzione* sono formati nella società di insegnamento e frequentano la scuola professionale per un massimo di un giorno alla settimana. Nella seconda metà dell'apprendistato, segue la formazione focalizzata sui lavori di manutenzione operativa. In questa fase di formazione, i tirocinanti approfondiscono le loro conoscenze e competenze attraverso l'apprendimento esemplare sui contratti di produzione e progetti.

At the Visp site, an apprentice production mechanic is sought. As a production mechanic at Lonza, you work in workshops and production facilities. You work metal components and assemble them into devices, apparatuses and machines. The production mechanics perform maintenance work on the chemical and biological production plants. You complete the orders and projects exactly and independently, partly in a team and together with other specialists. You mainly do planned maintenance work.

Your education
The teaching lasts three years. Production mechanics* are trained in the teaching company and attend the vocational school for a maximum of one day per week. During the first half of teaching, a broad foundation of knowledge and skills is laid in basic training. The focus is on working techniques such as manual and mechanical production technology, assembly technology, joining technology, commissioning, maintenance and subject-specific work safety. In the second half of the apprenticeship, the focus training for the operational maintenance works follows. In this training phase, the trainees deepen their knowledge and skills through exemplary learning on production contracts and projects.

Die Lehre dauert drei Jahre. Produktionsmechaniker*innen werden im Lehrbetrieb ausgebildet und besuchen während höchstens einem Tage pro Woche die Berufsschule. Während der 1. Lehrhälfte wird in der Grundausbildung ein breites Fundament an Wissen und Können gelegt. Lehrhälfte folgt die Schwerpunktausbildung für die betrieblichen Instandhaltungsarbeiten. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés dirigent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Sur le site de Visp, un apprenti mécanicien de production est recherché. En tant que mécanicien de production à Lonza, vous travaillez dans des ateliers et des installations de production. Vous travaillez des composants métalliques et les assemblez en appareils, appareils et machines. Les mécaniciens de production effectuent des travaux d'entretien sur les usines de production chimique et biologique. Vous réalisez les commandes et projets exactement et indépendamment, en partie en équipe et avec d'autres spécialistes. Vous effectuez principalement des travaux d'entretien planifiés.

Votre éducation
L'enseignement dure trois ans. Les mécaniciens de production* sont formés dans l'entreprise enseignante et fréquentent l'école professionnelle pendant une journée maximum par semaine. Au cours de la première moitié de l'enseignement, un large socle de connaissances et de compétences est posé dans la formation de base. L'accent est mis sur les techniques de travail telles que la technologie de production manuelle et mécanique, la technologie d'assemblage, la technologie d'assemblage, la mise en service, la maintenance et la sécurité au travail spécifique. Au cours de la deuxième moitié de l'apprentissage, la formation ciblée pour les travaux de maintenance opérationnelle suit. Dans cette phase de formation, les stagiaires approfondissent leurs connaissances et leurs compétences par un apprentissage exemplaire des contrats de production et des projets.

Votre profil

• Bonne compréhension pratique et technique

• Artisanat fort

• Travail précis et soigné

• Bonne imagination spatiale

• La joie au travail à la main et avec les machines

• Fiabilité

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau minimum B2)

Nous offrons
Chez Lonza, nous croyons fermement qu'en plus d'apprendre une profession, le développement personnel dès le premier jour est important. Nous formons donc nos apprenants non seulement en tant que professionnels qualifiés, mais aussi en tant que personnalités indépendantes. Cela vous permet de faire un début prometteur à votre carrière.

Dai diversi materiali, ma soprattutto dai metalli, si producono singoli componenti o interi impianti di produzione. Quando si producono singole parti o prototipi di costruzione, si lavora su torni, fresatura, foratura e rettificatrici. Con strumenti di misura e di prova ad alta precisione, si controlla finalmente la qualità dei pezzi. I polimeccanici sono responsabili dell'assemblaggio, manutenzione e messa in servizio di dispositivi, apparati, macchine e impianti. L'insegnamento dura quattro anni. I polimeccanici sono formati nella scuola di insegnamento e frequentano la scuola professionale per un massimo di due giorni alla settimana. Durante la prima metà dell'insegnamento, una vasta base di conoscenze e competenze è prevista nella formazione di base. Il focus è sulle tecniche di lavoro come la tecnologia di produzione manuale e meccanica, la tecnologia di assemblaggio, la tecnologia di unione,
Commissione, manutenzione e sicurezza tecnica sul lavoro. Nella seconda metà dell'apprendistato, la formazione al centro si svolge nelle aree operative di attività. In questa fase di formazione, i tirocinanti approfondiscono le loro conoscenze e competenze attraverso l'apprendimento esemplare sui contratti di produzione e progetti.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a student polymechanic is sought. As a polymechanic at Lonza, you produce workpieces as well as devices and tools for production. From different materials, but mainly from metals, you produce individual components or entire production plants. When manufacturing individual parts or building prototypes, you work on lathes, milling, drilling and grinding machines. With high-precision measuring and testing instruments, you finally check the quality of the workpieces. Polymechanics are responsible for the assembly, maintenance and commissioning of devices, apparatuses, machines and plants. New orders are discussed in the team and new ideas are developed together.

Your education
The teaching lasts four years. Polymechanics are trained in the teaching establishment and attend vocational school for a maximum of two days per week. During the first half of teaching, a broad foundation of knowledge and skills is laid in basic training. The focus is on working techniques such as manual and mechanical production technology, assembly technology, joining technology,
Commissioning, maintenance and technical safety at work. In the second half of the apprenticeship, the focus training follows in operational areas of activity. In this training phase, the trainees deepen their knowledge and skills through exemplary learning on production contracts and projects.

Your profile

• Interest in technical relationships and mechanics

• Precise and careful working methods

• Good spatial imagination

• Concentration, patience and endurance

• Teamwork

• Reliability

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Nel sito di Visp, viene cercato un costruttore di studenti. Come designer, si sviluppa, modella e progetta parti e assiemi individuali per dispositivi, macchine o impianti, nonché strumenti e dispositivi per la produzione in collaborazione con altri esperti. Per il funzionamento e la manutenzione dei prodotti, si creano istruzioni e documentazione. Come costruttore, crei modelli 3D e assemblaggi sul computer con programmi CAD e i loro disegni di progettazione 2D. Si effettuano i calcoli necessari e si tengono sui piani forme geometriche, masse e tolleranze, così come le informazioni sulla composizione superficiale e materiali. Sulla base di questi documenti, il pezzo o il montaggio viene poi prodotto in officina.

La tua istruzione
L'insegnamento dura quattro anni. La formazione pratica è completata da progettisti nella società di insegnamento. Questo è completato da corsi intercompany. Gli stage in altri campi professionali sono comuni. La scuola professionale è fondata nel 1° e 2° anno di apprendistato per due giorni e nel 3° e 4°. Anno di studio durante un giorno alla settimana.

• Interessi nei rapporti tecnici e nella meccanica

• Buona immaginazione spaziale

• Metodi di lavoro precisi e attenti

• Pazienza, resistenza e concentrazione

• Gioia del lavoro del computer

A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a learner constructor is sought. As a designer, you develop, model and design individual parts and assemblies for devices, machines or plants as well as tools and devices for production in cooperation with other experts. For the operation and maintenance of the products, you create instructions and documentation. As a constructor, you create 3D models and assemblies on the computer with CAD programs as well as their 2D design drawings. You make the necessary calculations and keep on the plans geometric shapes, masses and tolerances as well as information on surface composition and materials. On the basis of these documents, the workpiece or assembly is then produced in the workshop.

Your education
The teaching lasts four years. The practical training is completed by designers in the teaching company. This is complemented by intercompany courses. Internships in other professional fields are common. The vocational school is established in the 1st and 2nd year of apprenticeship for two days and in the 3rd and 4th. Study year during one day per week.

Your profile

• Interest in technical relationships and mechanics

• Good spatial imagination

• Precise and careful working methods

• Patience, endurance and concentration

• Joy of computer work

• Good team and communication skills

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

• Modern training in our own teaching companies

• Professional trainers*

• GA for CHF 1.- per day

• Teaching plus 1

• AFS – Year Abroad

• Learning WG

• Performance sports-friendly teaching

• 6 weeks of holidays per year

• Personal IT equipment

Please send us the following documents with your application:

• Letter of motivation

• CVC

• Copies of school certificates of the last two years

• Multicheck (if available)

• Test gauge reports (if any)

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a priority and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is joined by people who accept challenges and with their creativity in the field
Life Science develops new ideas for complex problems. Together we make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This offers them the certainty and satisfaction of really making a difference with their own work.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

At the Visp site, we are looking for an apprentice chemical and pharmacologist/technologist EFZ. Souvent vous travaillez en équipe, parce que plusieurs personnes sont nécessaires pour les activités de processus. Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp location, a learner*r automatic technician* is sought. As an automatic engineer, you develop electrical and pneumatic controls. You assemble and wire switchgear cabinets, carry out commissioning and maintenance work of controls and systems. In addition, you process plastic and metal housings, solder components on boards and create cables for connecting laboratory equipment and control systems. Repairing faulty devices is also part of your job. You work on assignments and projects together with other experts.

Your education
The teaching lasts four years. The practical training is completed by automatists in the teaching company. This is complemented by intercompany courses. You attend the vocational school for a maximum of two days per week. During the first half of teaching, a broad foundation of knowledge and skills is laid in basic training. The focus is on mechanical and electrical production technology, automation modules with topics such as measurement technology, circuit technology, electrical machines, measurement and control technology as well as subject-specific occupational safety.

Your profile

• Enthusiasm for experimentation and tinkering

• Technical understanding

• Analytical thinking and spatial imagination

• Interest in new technologies and electrical engineering

• Fine motor skills for accurate work

• Patience, perseverance and concentration

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, an apprentice plant and apparatus manufacturer is sought. As a plant and apparatus manufacturer at Lonza, you produce different products based on technical drawings. You mainly process various sheets, profiles and pipes. You combine them into components, containers, pipe systems or apparatus, which are then integrated into systems and plants. In addition, you take over the associated assembly, repair and repair work.
In the training workshop, the different techniques can be practiced on the different materials in order to later prepare the product correctly for the respective customer from production.

Your education
Plant and apparatus manufacturers* are trained for 4 years in teaching and specialist workshops with up to two days of vocational school visit per week.
During the basic training in the first half, knowledge and skills with a focus on sheet metal, metal profile and pipe processing will be applied through traditional tools as well as training on computer-controlled bending machines, welding robots and laser cutting equipment.
In the second half, there will be a focus training in operational areas of activity and specialist workshops, with deepening of expertise through practical learning projects for Lonza.

From the third year of apprenticeship, you will specialize in one of the different disciplines:

• Design technology

• Tube construction technology

• Welding technique

Your profile

• Interest in technical contexts and craftsmanship

• Good spatial imagination

• Good technical understanding

• Reliable, independent work

• No allergies to metals, fats and oils

• Teamwork

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

jobs.description:
Location: Stein (Switzerland)
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our antibody drug conjugate (ADC) manufacturing team as a Process Expert, where you will lead technical troubleshooting on an aseptic filling and lyophilization line, drive process improvements, train Operators on the line, manage deviations and technical changes, and help shape the future of a state-of-the-art production environment. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in ramping up a brand-new line—from PQ and qualification through to Swissmedic approval—with significant autonomy, decision-making responsibility, and the chance to define the processes that will set the standard for years to come. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

​What you’ll do:

• Act as the technical expert to ensure that the production line runs efficiently and effectively

• Coordinate and support the qualification of the manufacturing line, ensuring they meet strict industry standards

• Identify weaknesses in the production line and determine solutions to fix or investigate issues

• Establish, drive and maintain good cleanroom management practices

• Collaborate with team members and various internal functions (e.g. MSAT, QA, Engineering) to successfully implement improvements and new processes

What we’re looking for:

• Degree or equivalent experience in Life Science or Engineering

• Proven experience in EITHER aseptic filling or aseptic manufacturing in the GMP controlled environment is a must, additional experience in the qualification of manufacturing equipment is highly preferred

• Experience with lyophilization processes is highly preferred

• Proficiency in English is a must; German is a plus

• Ability to agilely move between various tasks during this dynamic and exciting project phase. You demonstrates strong collaboration skills and actively support your team members

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza!

Cosa otterrai:

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero.

Cosa farai:

• Agire come esperto tecnico per garantire che la linea di produzione funzioni in modo efficiente ed efficace

• Coordinare e sostenere la qualificazione della linea di produzione, assicurando loro di soddisfare rigidi standard industriali

• Identificare le debolezze della linea di produzione e determinare le soluzioni per risolvere o indagare i problemi

• Stabilire, guidare e mantenere buone pratiche di gestione delle cleanroom

• Collabora con i membri del team e varie funzioni interne (ad esempio MSAT, QA, Engineering) per implementare con successo miglioramenti e nuovi processi

Cosa stiamo cercando:

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.
While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

At Lonza, we are looking for an Executive Director, IT Business Partner – Advanced Synthesis to serve as the strategic interface between our business platform and IT, translating business priorities into technology-enabled solutions that accelerate growth, innovation, and operational excellence. This highly visible leadership role will shape the platform's digital strategy, technology roadmap, and investment priorities while ensuring IT capabilities deliver measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with business leaders, Digital & Data, Enterprise Solutions, Infrastructure, and Security teams, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of digital products, technology programmes, and platform transformation initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, you will ensure technology investments are aligned with business strategy, enabling scalable, compliant, and future-ready operations across Lonza's global manufacturing network.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to business platform leadership, aligning technology strategy with business priorities, operational objectives, and long-term growth plans

• Shape and execute the platform's multi-year technology roadmap, identifying digital transformation opportunities and enabling business value through data, automation, AI, and enterprise technologies

• Own the end-to-end demand management, prioritization, and delivery of platform-specific digital products and IT initiatives, ensuring alignment with business strategy and cross-platform standards

• Lead the platform IT portfolio, including business case development, investment prioritization, resource allocation, and execution governance

• Partner with Enterprise Solutions, Digital & Data, Infrastructure, Security, and Site IT teams to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant technology solutions across manufacturing, quality, ERP/MES, automation, and data platforms

• Support major platform expansion initiatives, capital projects, and M&A activities by ensuring technology readiness and successful IT integration

• Build trusted relationships across business leadership, manufacturing sites, quality, supply chain, and other key stakeholders, acting as the primary advisor on technology strategy and digital innovation

descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist.
Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine Zauberformel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Bei Lonza suchen wir einen Executive Director, IT Business Partner – Advanced Synthesis, der als strategische Schnittstelle zwischen unserer Geschäftsplattform und der IT dient und Geschäftsprioritäten in technologiegestützte Lösungen übersetzt, die Wachstum, Innovation und operative Exzellenz beschleunigen. Diese sehr sichtbare Führungsrolle wird die digitale Strategie, die Technologie-Roadmap und die Investitionsprioritäten der Plattform prägen und gleichzeitig sicherstellen, dass IT-Fähigkeiten messbare Geschäftsergebnisse liefern.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmensleitern, Digital & Data, Enterprise Solutions, Infrastruktur und Sicherheitsteams werden Sie die End-to-End-Bereitstellung digitaler Produkte, Technologieprogramme und Plattformtransformationsinitiativen vorantreiben. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte stellen Sie sicher, dass Technologieinvestitionen an der Geschäftsstrategie ausgerichtet sind und skalierbare, konforme und zukunftsfähige Operationen im globalen Fertigungsnetzwerk von Lonza ermöglichen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Als primärer strategischer IT-Partner für die Führung von Geschäftsplattformen dienen und die Technologiestrategie an Geschäftsprioritäten, operativen Zielen und langfristigen Wachstumsplänen ausrichten

• Gestalten und implementieren Sie die mehrjährige Technologie-Roadmap der Plattform, identifizieren Sie digitale Transformationsmöglichkeiten und ermöglichen Sie den Geschäftswert durch Daten, Automatisierung, KI und Unternehmenstechnologien

• Eigenes End-to-End-Demand-Management, Priorisierung und Bereitstellung von plattformspezifischen digitalen Produkten und IT-Initiativen, um die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsstrategie und plattformübergreifende Standards sicherzustellen

• Führen Sie das Plattform-IT-Portfolio, einschließlich Business Case-Entwicklung, Investitionspriorisierung, Ressourcenzuweisung und Execution Governance

• Partnerschaft mit IT-Teams für Enterprise Solutions, Digital & Data, Infrastructure, Security und Site, um skalierbare, sichere und konforme Technologielösungen für Fertigung, Qualität, ERP/MES, Automatisierung und Datenplattformen bereitzustellen

• Unterstützung von großen Plattformerweiterungsinitiativen, Kapitalprojekten und M&A-Aktivitäten durch Sicherstellung der Technologiebereitschaft und erfolgreichen IT-Integration

• Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zwischen Unternehmensführung, Fertigungsstandorten, Qualität, Lieferkette und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern, die als Hauptberater für Technologiestrategie und digitale Innovation fungieren

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen an IT-Governance, Cybersicherheit, GxP, Regulierung und Datenintegrität bei gleichzeitiger Unterstützung von Audits und Plattform-Governance-Aktivitäten

• Überwachen Sie die Portfolio-Performance durch KPIs, Wertrealisierungsmetriken und operative Leistungsüberprüfungen, um die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von IT-Services und digitalen Funktionen voranzutreiben

• Leitung und Entwicklung von Plattform-IT-Teams, einschließlich Site IT Leaders und Product Owners, Förderung der Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten, Zusammenarbeit und einer Kultur der Innovation und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

Vorgeschriebene Qualifikationen:

• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in IT Leadership, IT Business Partnering, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications oder Technologiestrategie in globalen Organisationen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Partnerschaft mit leitenden Führungskräften, um Technologiestrategien zu definieren und messbare Geschäftsergebnisse zu liefern

• Starkes Verständnis von Fertigungs-IT, Unternehmensplattformen, digitalen Produkten, Automatisierung, Daten, KI, ERP/MES-Umgebungen und technologiegestützter Geschäftstransformation

• Erleben Sie führende komplexe Technologieportfolios, digitale Produktbereitstellung und funktionsübergreifende Programme in matrixisierten Organisationen

• Starkes Wissen über regulierte Branchen wie Biowissenschaften, Pharma, Biotechnologie, Medizinprodukte oder fortschrittliche Fertigung

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, hochrangige Stakeholder zu beeinflussen, konkurrierende Prioritäten zu verwalten und strategische Entscheidungen ohne direkte Autorität voranzutreiben

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management, Beratung und Executive-Präsentation Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Technologie-Themen in Business Value zu übersetzen

• Starkes analytisches, strategisches Denken und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit Erfahrung beim Aufbau von Geschäftsfällen und bei der Wertrealisierung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich erforderlich; Master-Abschluss bevorzugt

• Leidenschaft für Innovation, digitale Transformation und den Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams in einem schnelllebigen, globalen Umfeld

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht - die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten eine Gegenleistung für eine Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Status als qualifizierte Person mit Behinderung, geschützter Veteranenstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents.
Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Chez Lonza, nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur exécutif, IT Business Partner – Advanced Synthesis, qui servira d'interface stratégique entre notre plateforme d'affaires et l'informatique, transformant les priorités commerciales en solutions technologiques qui accélèrent la croissance, l'innovation et l'excellence opérationnelle. Ce rôle de leadership très visible façonnera la stratégie numérique, la feuille de route technologique et les priorités d'investissement de la plateforme, tout en veillant à ce que les capacités de TI produisent des résultats opérationnels mesurables.

En étroite collaboration avec les chefs d'entreprise, les équipes Digital & Data, Enterprise Solutions, Infrastructure et Sécurité, vous dirigerez la livraison de bout en bout de produits numériques, de programmes technologiques et d'initiatives de transformation des plateformes. En tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des intervenants exécutifs, vous veillerez à ce que les investissements technologiques soient alignés sur la stratégie commerciale, ce qui permettra des opérations évolutives, conformes et prêtes à l'avenir dans le réseau mondial de fabrication de Lonza.

Principales responsabilités

• Servir de principal partenaire stratégique de la TI au leadership des plateformes d'affaires, en alignant la stratégie technologique sur les priorités opérationnelles, les objectifs opérationnels et les plans de croissance à long terme

• Former et exécuter la feuille de route technologique pluriannuelle de la plateforme, en identifiant les possibilités de transformation numérique et en permettant la valeur commerciale grâce aux technologies de données, d'automatisation, d'IA et d'entreprise

• Posséder la gestion de la demande de bout en bout, la hiérarchisation et la livraison de produits numériques et d'initiatives informatiques spécifiques à la plateforme, en assurant l'alignement sur la stratégie opérationnelle et les normes multiplateformes

• Diriger le portefeuille de TI de la plateforme, y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation, la hiérarchisation des investissements, l'affectation des ressources et la gouvernance de l'exécution

• Partenaire avec les équipes Enterprise Solutions, Digital & Data, Infrastructure, Sécurité et Site IT pour fournir des solutions technologiques évolutives, sécurisées et conformes à toutes les plateformes de fabrication, de qualité, ERP/MES, d'automatisation et de données

• Appuyer les principales initiatives d'expansion de la plateforme, les projets d'immobilisations et les activités de fusion-acquisition en assurant la disponibilité technologique et l'intégration réussie des TI

• Établir des relations de confiance entre les chefs d'entreprise, les sites de fabrication, la qualité, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et d'autres intervenants clés, agissant à titre de conseiller principal sur la stratégie technologique et l'innovation numérique

• Assurer la conformité avec les exigences en matière de gouvernance des TI, de cybersécurité, de GxP, de réglementation et d'intégrité des données tout en appuyant les vérifications et les activités de gouvernance des plateformes

• Surveiller la performance du portefeuille à l'aide des ICR, des indicateurs de réalisation de la valeur et des examens de la performance opérationnelle, en favorisant l'amélioration continue des services informatiques et des capacités numériques

• Diriger et mettre au point des équipes de TI, y compris des dirigeants de TI sur place et des propriétaires de produits, en favorisant le développement des capacités, la collaboration et une culture d'innovation et d'amélioration continue

Compétences requises:

• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en leadership informatique, partenariat d'affaires en TI, transformation numérique, applications d'entreprise ou stratégie technologique au sein des organisations mondiales

• Expérience éprouvée en partenariat avec des chefs d'entreprise principaux pour définir la stratégie technologique et obtenir des résultats mesurables

• Forte compréhension de la fabrication de l'informatique, des plateformes d'entreprise, des produits numériques, de l'automatisation, des données, de l'IA, des environnements ERP/MES et de la transformation des activités grâce à la technologie

• Expérience de portefeuilles technologiques complexes de premier plan, de livraison de produits numériques et de programmes interfonctionnels au sein des organisations matricielles

• Forte connaissance des industries réglementées comme les sciences de la vie, les produits pharmaceutiques, la biotechnologie, les dispositifs médicaux ou la fabrication avancée

• Capacité démontrée d'influencer les principaux intervenants, de gérer des priorités concurrentes et de diriger les décisions stratégiques sans pouvoir direct

• Excellente capacité de communication, de gestion des intervenants, de consultation et de présentation des cadres avec la capacité de traduire des sujets technologiques complexes en valeur opérationnelle

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de réflexion stratégique et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'expérience de la création d'analyses de rentabilisation et la réalisation de valeurs motrices

• Baccalauréat en technologie de l'information, informatique, ingénierie, affaires ou un domaine connexe requis; diplôme de maîtrise préféré

• Passion pour l'innovation, la transformation numérique et la constitution d'équipes performantes dans un environnement mondial rapide

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès, sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration des vies partout dans le monde - la satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi sans égard à la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'âge, le statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, le statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.
