jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The QA Infrastructure and Logistics group provides key QA oversight and support for the Switzerland-VISP site. This group supports the site utilities, warehousing, and movement of raw materials and products in and out of facilities.

This position will focus on implementing and managing robust cross-functional support of legacy and new facilities. You will be responsible for assuring Quality Assurance of Lonza’s sites and facilities, whilst ensuring shared utility systems and logistics areas are carried out by Lonza's standards, industry best practices, and the requirements of national and international regulatory agencies.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Provide QA support for Project and Operations internal customers in the following areas: GMP & Compliance, Cold-chain, supply chain, good warehousing practice, and Clean utilities.

• Provide Quality Assurance oversight to the site and facilities focusing on shared utility systems and logistics areas.

• Organize and lead Deviation Review Boards for Utilities & Logistics related deviations.

• Review and assess Change Requests and Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA).

• Review and approve standard operation procedures for shared utility systems and logistics.

• Review and assess GMP impact of utility and cold-chain alarms and incidents.

• Assist with operational readiness activities and assess their risks in the relevant areas.

• Support internal and external audits, and inspections and represent the Quality function at relevant meetings.

• Leads or supports local implementation of global Quality policies and standards in his/her area of responsibility.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences/ Biochemistry or Supply Chain/Logistics or related field.

• Relevant work experience in Quality Assurance and/or Production/Supply Chain/Logistics and/or Quality Control in pharmaceutical industries and cGMP-controlled environments.

• Knowledge of Swiss, EU, and US GMP regulations relevant to audit/inspections and compliance systems.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills (English required, German is an advantage).

• Ability to communicate quality and compliance requirements to varying levels and functions of the organization.

• Strong collaborative mindset and the ability to build relationships quickly.

• Strong organizational skills, and ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Ability to solve problems, understand details and strategic picture, providing practical solutions.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What you will do:

• Perform all duties to ensure the Materials Requirements Plans are completed to ensure the timely availability of materials to support the product Supply Plan

• Responsible to liaise with all key functions to ensure timely updates to material plans considering changes to plans or material availability issues

• Execution of key tasks to support inventory plans and optimization initiatives

• Perform all routine tasks to convert planned orders into material plans (Purchase Requisition, BANF) including the creation and management of material planned requirements

• Liaison with Material Project Leads (MPLs) to ensure all material plans are up to date and responsive to changes in material requirements

• Creation and maintenance of detailed material planning parameters in Planning systems

• Conversion of the material requirements plan (purchase requisitions) into Purchase Orders

• Expediting material availability through liaison with procurement and teams involved with inbound material processing

• Creation and management of material related KPIs and measures to ensure accurate understanding of material availability

• Execution of key material availability, mobilization or write actions to support optimal management of inventory while reducing scrap/waste (SMOG)

• Liase with key stakeholders (MPLs, Material Analysts) to develop safety stock and inventory plans to meet production plans

• Close cooperation with Operational Buyers for supplier related questions

• Track, report and facilitate on-time material availability (drive escalations) including testing and accountability with material releases for production

What we are looking for:

• Degree or equivalent experience in SCM, Procurement or any relevant field

• Min. of 5 years’ experience as a Material Requirement Planner

• Required CPIM certification

• Experience in SCM, Materials Planning/Scheduling and/or Purchasing

• Good knowledge of SAP, especially MM and MS Office (Excel, Powerpoint), PowerBI

• Good communication and presentation skils

• Fluency in German or English is required. Both will be preferred.

• Strong Teammate and able to work across cross-functional teams

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Cosa farai:

• Eseguire tutte le funzioni per garantire i piani di requisiti dei materiali sono completati per garantire la tempestiva disponibilità dei materiali per supportare il piano di fornitura del prodotto

• Responsabile del collegamento con tutte le funzioni chiave per garantire l'aggiornamento tempestivo dei piani materiali considerando le modifiche ai piani o ai problemi di disponibilità dei materiali

• Esecuzione di compiti chiave per sostenere piani di inventario e iniziative di ottimizzazione

• Eseguire tutte le attività di routine per convertire gli ordini pianificati in piani materiali (Purchase Requisition, BANF) tra cui la creazione e la gestione dei requisiti materiali pianificati

• Il collegamento con il progetto materiale porta (MPL) per garantire che tutti i piani materiali siano aggiornati e reattivi ai cambiamenti dei requisiti materiali

• Creazione e manutenzione di parametri di pianificazione dei materiali dettagliati nei sistemi di pianificazione

• Conversione del piano dei requisiti materiali (requisizioni acquisti) in ordini di acquisto

• Spedizioni della disponibilità dei materiali attraverso il collegamento con gli appalti e i team coinvolti nella lavorazione dei materiali in entrata

• Creazione e gestione di KPI e misure relative ai materiali per garantire una comprensione accurata della disponibilità dei materiali

• Esecuzione della disponibilità di materiale chiave, mobilitazione o azioni di scrittura per sostenere la gestione ottimale dell'inventario, riducendo al contempo rottami / rifiuti (SMOG)

• Locazione con i principali stakeholder (MPL, Analisti dei Materiali) per sviluppare azioni di sicurezza e piani di inventario per soddisfare i piani di produzione

• Chiudere la collaborazione con gli acquirenti operativi per le domande relative ai fornitori

• Tracciare, segnalare e facilitare la disponibilità del materiale in tempo reale (escavazioni di guida) tra cui test e responsabilitÃ con comunicati materiali per la produzione

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Esperienza di laurea o equivalente in SCM, appalti o qualsiasi campo rilevante

• Min. di 5 anni di esperienza come pianificatore di requisiti materiali

• Certificazione CPIM richiesta

• Esperienza in SCM, Pianificazione dei materiali/Scheduling e/o Acquisti

• Buona conoscenza di SAP, in particolare MM e MS Office (Excel, Powerpoint), PowerBI

• Buona comunicazione e presentazione scils

• È richiesta una fluidità in tedesco o in inglese. Entrambi saranno preferiti.

• Forte compagno di squadra e in grado di lavorare tra le squadre interfunzionali

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica subito!

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Liaison avec les responsables de projets matériels (LPM) pour s'assurer que tous les plans matériels sont à jour et adaptés aux changements dans les exigences matérielles

• Création et maintenance de paramètres détaillés de planification matérielle dans les systèmes de planification

• Conversion du plan des besoins en matériel (demandes d'achat) en bons de commande

• Accélérer la disponibilité des matériaux grâce à la liaison avec les achats et les équipes chargées du traitement des matériaux entrants

• Création et gestion d'ICP liés au matériel et mesures visant à assurer une compréhension exacte de la disponibilité du matériel

• Exécution d'actions clés en matière de disponibilité du matériel, de mobilisation ou d'écriture pour soutenir une gestion optimale des stocks tout en réduisant la ferraille/déchets (SMOG)

• Liaison avec les principaux intervenants (LPM, Analystes du matériel) afin d'élaborer des plans de sécurité et d'inventaire pour respecter les plans de production

• Coopération étroite avec les acheteurs opérationnels pour les questions relatives aux fournisseurs

• Suivre, signaler et faciliter la disponibilité en temps voulu du matériel (processus d'escalade), y compris les essais et la responsabilisation concernant les rejets de matériel destinés à la production

Ce que nous cherchons :

• Degré ou expérience équivalente en MSC, en Approvisionnement ou dans tout domaine pertinent

• Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience comme planificateur d'exigences matérielles

• Certification requise du MIPC

• Expérience en GCS, planification/planification des matériaux et/ou achats

• Bonne connaissance de SAP, en particulier MM et MS Office (Excel, Powerpoint), PowerBI

• Bonne communication et présentation

• La maîtrise de l'allemand ou de l'anglais est requise. Les deux seront préférés.

• Forte coéquipière et capable de travailler entre équipes interfonctionnelles

À propos de Lonza

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et ça, c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Postulez !

jobs.description:
Operations Support: Operations Support Specialist, Large Scale Mammalian

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula for how we do it. Our greatest scientific solutions are dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for Operations Support and Manufacturing Specialists for our 6x20K Large Scale Mammalian Facility. In this role, you will be responsible for performing operational activities within the Operations Support Team in partnership with Buffer Media Supply, USP and DSP.

What you’ll do:

• Assignments within the Operations Support team focused on receipt and management of raw materials, single use materials, dispensing of small volume and large-scale medias and buffers.

• Processing of parts in washers and autoclaves

• Transport and storage of materials within temperature-controlled requirements

• Recognition, interpretation, and elimination of deviations

• Execution of tasks in compliance with safety regulations and cGMP quality requirements.

• Execution of production steps including interaction with HMIs and automated systems

• Support on-going training to develop your technical skills in a fast paced, large scale mammalian facility (6 x 20K Bioreactors)

What we’re looking for:

• Fluent English with German language skills advantageous

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or vocational training preferred

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician in a GMP environment is a plus

• Safety mindset; forklift and/or electric pallet truck training will be required

• Continuous improvement mindset with attention to detail and support of 6S standards

• Willingness to work in shifts (e.g. 2 or 3-shift pattern) with flexible work scheduling

• Day shift schedule to start during training period and establishment of the Operations Support Department.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Supporto Operazioni: Specialista di Supporto Operazioni, Grande Scala Mammiferi

Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. Le nostre più grandi soluzioni scientifiche sono persone dedicate che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda la propria carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.
A causa della crescita nel nostro sito a Visp, stiamo attualmente cercando Operations Support and Manufacturing Specialists per la nostra Facility 6x20K Large Scale Mammalian. In questo ruolo, sarai responsabile dell'esecuzione di attività operative all'interno del Team Operazioni di Supporto in collaborazione con Buffer Media Supply, USP e DSP.

Cosa farai:

• Assegnazioni all'interno del team Operations Support focalizzate sul ricevimento e sulla gestione di materie prime, materiali di uso singolo, erogazione di piccoli volumi e supporti su larga scala e buffer.

• Lavorazione di parti in lavatrici e autoclavi

• Trasporto e stoccaggio di materiali all'interno di requisiti controllati dalla temperatura

• Riconoscimento, interpretazione e eliminazione delle deviazioni

• Esecuzione dei compiti nel rispetto delle norme di sicurezza e dei requisiti di qualità cGMP.

• Esecuzione delle fasi di produzione, compresa l'interazione con HMI e sistemi automatizzati

• Supporto formazione in corso per sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche in una struttura mammifera veloce e su larga scala (6 x 20K Bioreattori)

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Inglese fluente con competenze di lingua tedesca vantaggioso

• Preferito l'istruzione chimica / biofarmaceutica o la formazione professionale

• Esperienza professionale nella produzione farmaceutica come operatore / tecnico di produzione in un ambiente GMP è un plus

• Attenzione di sicurezza; carrello elevatore e/o addestramento del carrello elettrico

• Mente di miglioramento continuo con attenzione ai dettagli e supporto agli standard 6S

• Volontà di lavoro a turni (per esempio 2 o 3 turni) con programmazione flessibile del lavoro

• Programma di turni di giorno per iniziare durante il periodo di formazione e l'istituzione del Dipartimento di Supporto Operazioni.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, stato veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland. Eligible applicants and their families will be assisted in moving if needed.

We are currently looking for a clean room cleaning employee in the PCP/PCPSS (m/f/d). The cleanroom cleaning employee is responsible for the correct implementation of the cleanroom in the PCP and PCPSS plants to ensure a safe quality for the cleanroom. This includes the implementation of the corresponding SOPs of the hygiene, room cleaning and growing concepts. You are also responsible for the material management of the hygiene articles in the company, as well as the implementation of internal tours in the technical areas.

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Our full list of local benefits can be found below:

• Benefits in Visp

Their tasks:

• Implementation of room cleaning in qualified rooms under clean room conditions in accordance with applicable operating and working regulations:
- Cleaning of ceilings, walls, windows and floors
- Cleaning of equipment and equipment

• Management of sanitary and clothing articles:
- Refilling of consumables
- Order of required items
- Transfer of materials into the clean room area

• Implementation of in-house tours

• GMP-compliant documentation

What we are looking for:

• Completed vocational apprenticeship

• Experience in a GMP environment and already acquired knowledge of the high demands of a clean room

• Willingness to work in a clean room under special hygiene articles

• Knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel and Word)

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing

​
About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

• In-depth knowledge of process plants and automation systems, especially DeltaV.

• Strong technical understanding and the ability to address technical challenges in a structured and solution-oriented manner.

• Experience in the preparation and maintenance of GMP-relevant documentation as well as in cooperation with cross-functional teams.

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing.

• Commitment to continuous improvement and high standards in safety, quality and compliance.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Apply now.

MINTworld è un'iniziativa congiunta di Lonza AG a Visp e nel Cantone di Wallis. Inizio dello stage: dal dicembre 2026

Cosa ti aspetta:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi, a seconda della funzione e della posizione.

I vostri compiti:

• Assistenza nello sviluppo e nell'ampliamento dell'offerta

• Sostegno di istruttori di corsi nell'organizzazione e nell'attuazione di vari workshop MINT

• Gestione indipendente dei workshop

• A seconda della qualifica, possibilità di svolgere attività di ricerca di supporto in un moderno laboratorio industriale (ad esempio HPLC, GC, titolazione, cultura cellulare, fermentazione, strutture sperimentali, automazione di laboratorio)

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Formazione professionale completata o Matura in un'area STEM-relevant o studi in corso presso un istituto tecnico o universitario nella zona STEM

• In alternativa, anche le parti interessate con formazione pedagogica o didattica, nello studio o nella pianificazione di tale studio

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco; La conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio.

• Idealmente, esperienza pratica iniziale in una o più delle seguenti aree: attività di laboratorio, CNC, stampa 3D, elettronica o informatica

• Interessi nello sviluppo attivo e nella ricerca di un'azienda che offre spazio per contribuire e implementare idee creative

• Lavoro di squadra e lavoro indipendente e orientato alla soluzione.

• Motivazione per collaborare con i giovani in un ambiente educativo e multiculturale

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.

A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

MINTworld is a joint initiative of Lonza AG in Visp and the Canton of Wallis. On an area of around 1000 m2, it offers children and adolescents both during school and in their free time the opportunity to discover the diverse disciplines of STEM (mathematics, computer science, science and technology) in a practical manner. Compatible with curriculum 21, theory and practice can be combined in a playful and exciting way. More information can be found at www.mintworld.ch.

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

Start of the internship: from December 2026

What is waiting for you:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location.

Your tasks:

• Development and conception of new workshops in close cooperation with the team

• Assistance in developing and expanding the offer

• Support of course instructors in the organisation and implementation of various MINT workshops

• Independent management of workshops

• Depending on the qualification, possibility to carry out supporting research activities in a modern industrial laboratory (e.g. HPLC, GC, titration, cell culture, fermentation, experimental facilities, laboratory automation)

• Ideally, initial practical experience in one or more of the following areas: laboratory activities, CNC, 3D printing, electronics or computer science

• Motivation to collaborate with young people in an educational and multicultural environment

The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland. Eligible applicants and their families will be assisted in moving if needed.

At our location in Visp, we are looking for specialists in the field of chemical pharmaceutical production Visp MES(Syncade)/DCS(DeltaV).

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. jobs.description:
Ort: Visp (Schweiz)
Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du die Qualitätskontrolle der Biologics-Produktion am Standort Visp. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, dass Medikamente weltweit sicher und wirksam eingesetzt werden können. Der Job bietet Abwechslung, Verantwortung und attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – im modernen Labor und im gut strukturierten 4‑Schicht‑Modell.

Was du bekommst

• Ein modernes Laborumfeld mit erstklassiger Ausstattung.

• Eine inklusive, kollegiale Arbeitskultur mit klaren Entwicklungspfaden.

• ÖV-Unterstützung, Aktienprogramme, erweiterte Elternzeit und starke Pensionskassenleistungen; Alle lokalen Benefits am Standort Visp

• Drei interne Analysten-Stufen für eine Karriere ohne Führungsverantwortung und die Möglichkeit bis zu 150 verschiedene Methoden zu erlernen.

• Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Spezialisierungsmöglichkeiten.

Dein Arbeitsplatz
Unser Labor wurde 2022 neu gebaut – modern, effizient und technisch auf dem neuesten Stand. Wir leben eine offene Feedback-Kultur: Verbesserungsvorschläge von Analystinnen und Analysten werden ernst genommen, bewertet und aktiv umgesetzt (Kaizen-Prinzip). Wir wollen jeden Tag besser werden – gemeinsam und mit echtem Teamgeist.

Was du tust

• Du führst mikrobiologische, biochemische und physikalisch‑chemische Analysen unter GMP-Bedingungen durch, z.B. Bioburden, Endotoxin, HPLC / Chromatographie, UV oder TOC

• Du stellst im 4‑Schicht‑Betrieb die zeitkritische Analyse und Freigabe von Produktions-Chargen sicher.

• Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse präzise und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen.

• Du unterstützt kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse nach dem Kaizen-Prinzip.

• Du entwickelst dich fachlich weiter – als Spezialist/in oder Generalist/in, je nach deinen Interessen.

Was du mitbringst

• Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in EFZ oder eine naturwissenschaftlich-technische Ausbildung. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger/innen mit Erfahrung in Schichtarbeit und/oder in einem regulierten, hygienisch kontrollierten Arbeitsumfeld werden berücksichtigt.

• Erste Laborerfahrung und GMP-Kenntnisse sind ein Vorteil.

• Freude an präziser Laborarbeit, Verantwortung und Qualitätsbewusstsein.

• Deutsch-Kenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau B1; Englisch-Kenntnisse von Vorteil.

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 4‑Schicht‑Modell (Frühschicht 5:00Uhr) und Wohnort in erreichbarer Nähe zu Visp.

• Hands-on Mentalität, Teamfähigkeit und Motivation für langfristige Entwicklung.

Über Lonza
Lonza zählt zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen der Life‑Sciences‑Industrie. Unsere Teams entwickeln und produzieren gemeinsam Therapien und Technologien, die das Leben von Menschen weltweit verbessern. Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortung, Qualität, Leidenschaft und Integrität prägen unsere Arbeitsweise. Jede Idee – groß oder klein – kann einen Unterschied machen.
Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden sich einbringen und weiterentwickeln können. Wenn du Teil eines Teams sein möchtest, das täglich an Lösungen für die Gesundheit von morgen arbeitet, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

In this role, you support the quality control of biologics production at the Visp site. Your work directly contributes to the safe and effective use of drugs worldwide. The job offers variety, responsibility and attractive development opportunities – in the modern laboratory and in the well-structured 4-layer model.

What you get

• A modern laboratory environment with first-class equipment.

• An inclusive, collegial work culture with clear development paths.

• public transport support, share programmes, extended parental leave and strong pension benefits; All local benefits at the Visp location

• Three internal analyst levels for a career without leadership responsibility and the opportunity to learn up to 150 different methods.

• Diverse training and specialization opportunities.

Your workplace
Our laboratory was rebuilt in 2022 – modern, efficient and technically up-to-date. We live an open feedback culture: suggestions for improvement by analysts are taken seriously, evaluated and actively implemented (Kaizen principle). We want to be better every day – together and with a real team spirit.

What you do

• You perform microbiological, biochemical and physical-chemical analyses under GMP conditions, e.g. bioburden, endotoxin, HPLC / chromatography, UV or TOC

• You ensure the time-critical analysis and release of production batches in 4-shift operation.

• You document results accurately and work closely with different teams.

• You support continuous improvement processes according to the Kaizen principle.

• You develop professionally – as a specialist or generalist, depending on your interests.

What you bring

• A completed training as a laboratory assistant or a scientific-technical training. Also motivated lateral entrants with experience in shift work and/or in a regulated, hygienic controlled working environment are considered.

• Initial laboratory experience and GMP knowledge are an advantage.

• Enjoying precise laboratory work, responsibility and quality awareness.

• German skills at least at level B1; English skills are beneficial.

• Readiness to work in the 4-shift model (early shift 5:00 clock) and place of residence near Visp.

• Hands-on mentality, teamwork and motivation for long-term development.

• Manage supplier relationships and drive Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) initiatives through regular business reviews, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement plans.

• Oversee vendor performance, identifying opportunities to improve delivery reliability, quality, service levels, and regulatory compliance.

• Drive digitalization and process standardization across procurement activities, ensuring effective use of SAP and other procurement tools.

• Collaborate closely with Planning, Logistics, Quality Assurance, Finance, and other stakeholders to support operational excellence and supply chain objectives.

• Contribute to supply chain transformation and improvement projects, including material creation, supplier onboarding, certificate management, logistics optimization, and invoicing process enhancements.

What we are looking for:

You will support the QA topic of facility operation as well as pest control within the CPC (Contamination Prevention & Control) department at one of the largest biologics manufacturing sites in the world, where reliable utility systems, robust facility interfaces, and effective pest control are critical enablers of contamination prevention, GMP compliance, and reliable manufacturing operations.

• Own QA governance for facility operation and pest control topics, including deviation and change review, GMP document review and approval, CAPA oversight, trend review, and quality risk assessments.

What we are looking for:

Dans ce rôle principal, vous relierez les services publics, l'infrastructure et la lutte antiparasitaire au cadre plus général de prévention et de lutte contre la contamination. Vous aiderez à s'assurer que les systèmes d'utilité publique du site, les interfaces d'infrastructure, les interfaces de construction, les activités de lutte antiparasitaire et les interfaces des installations de BPF demeurent conformes, fiables, prêts à être inspectés et alignés sur l'état de contrôle soutenu attendu dans tout le site de Visp.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une place dans une équipe inclusive, dynamique et passionnée. Une vaste gamme de sujets d'AQ à fort impact dans le cadre de la stratégie de lutte contre la contamination, reliant les services publics, l'infrastructure, la lutte antiparasitaire et les opérations sur place à la prévention et à la lutte contre la contamination.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

Ce que vous ferez :

• Appuyer l'exploitation de l'installation d'AQ et la lutte antiparasitaire dans le cadre de la SCC, en fournissant une orientation technique de haut niveau, des conseils axés sur les risques et des décisions pratiques de qualité dans l'ensemble du site de Viège.

• Assurer la surveillance de l'AQ pour les systèmes d'utilité publique du site, l'exploitation des installations, la lutte antiparasitaire, les interfaces de construction et les interfaces des BPF, en mettant l'accent sur la contamination microbienne et la prévention de la contamination croisée, la conformité aux BPF et la préparation à l'inspection.

• Sa propre gouvernance en matière d'AQ pour l'exploitation des installations et la lutte antiparasitaire, y compris l'examen des écarts et des changements, l'examen et l'approbation des BPF, la surveillance de l'ACAP, l'examen des tendances et les évaluations des risques de qualité.

• Conduire l'amélioration continue des systèmes de qualité, de la préparation à l'inspection, des normes de conformité et de l'exécution pratique des BPF sur le site de Viège.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Diplôme universitaire en sciences de la vie, génie, sciences pharmaceutiques, biotechnologie, qualité ou autre discipline pertinente.

• Expérience importante dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques ou de biotechnologies réglementés par les BPF, de préférence en ce qui a trait à l'exposition aux services publics, à l'infrastructure, aux systèmes d'installations, à la qualification, à l'ingénierie, à la lutte antiparasitaire ou aux opérations de qualité du site.

• Forte expérience de l'AQ dans la conduite de sujets techniques ou opérationnels complexes, l'influence des intervenants interfonctionnels et la conduite de décisions fondées sur le risque sans responsabilité directe de la direction hiérarchique.

• Bonne connaissance des exigences des BPF, des systèmes de qualité, des écarts, des APC, des contrôles du changement, de la gestion des risques, des inspections et des vérifications.

• L'expérience des services publics, de l'infrastructure, de la lutte antiparasitaire, de l'état de préparation des installations, des interfaces techniques, des interfaces de construction ou du transfert de projets est très souhaitée.

• Bonne compréhension des principes de prévention de la contamination, des opérations des salles propres, des services publics qualifiés, des interfaces des BPF, des attentes en matière de lutte antiparasitaire et de la préparation à l'inspection.

jobs.description:
Ort: Visp (Schweiz)

Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Als Mitglied der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) bist du verantwortlich für die praktische Durchführung eines breiten Spektrums an biochemischer Methoden zur Charakterisierung von komplexen und hoch aktiven konjugierten Antikörperwirkstoffen (aber auch anderer Biomoleküle) unter GMP. Bei den Biokonjugaten handelt es sich um eine innovative Klasse an Wirkstoffen, in die u.a. in der Krebstherapie grosse Hoffnungen gesetzt werden.

Das Biochemie Team arbeitet vorwiegend mit Biokonjugaten und gehört zur Abteilung QC-Biologie. Zur Verstärkung unseres Labor-Teams suchen wir eine/n Junior Scientist.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben wettbewerbsfähigen Gehältern finden Sie eine breite Palette an Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteilen. Je nach Standort können diese Vorteile Familienzulagen, Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Rabatte für lokale Unternehmen und Attraktionen, Reisekostenzuschüsse und subventionierte Mahlzeiten umfassen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Selbstständige Anwendung biochemischer Analysenverfahren mit Schwerpunkt auf ELISA, Gel-Elektrophorese und rDNA-Analytik.

• Mitarbeit bei Methodenentwicklung, -implementierung, -transfer und -validierung sowie bei der Auswertung von Daten und Lösung analytischer Fragestellungen – insbesondere im Bereich zellbasierter Assays.

• Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Freigabetests sowie fachliche Unterstützung bei analytischen und technischen Fragestellungen im GMP-Umfeld.

• Selbstständige Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, Änderungsanträgen und Untersuchungen im Rahmen der regulatorischen Anforderungen.

• Auswertung und Interpretation analytischer Daten sowie Erstellung von wissenschaftlichen Berichten und Präsentationen.

• Verfassen, Prüfen und Freigeben qualitätsrelevanter Dokumente zur Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher und interner Vorgaben.

• Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung der zugewiesenen Aufgaben im Rahmen von Studien und Projekten mit Fokus auf Qualität, Sicherheit und Termintreue.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (BSc oder höher) in Biologie, Biochemie, Chemie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet

• Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung in der Qualitätskontrolle oder Analytik von Biopharmazeutika, vorzugsweise im regulierten GMP-Umfeld

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Übernahme von Verantwortung und aktive Einbringung fachlicher Expertise im Team

• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein, Eigeninitiative und Engagement

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Se necessario, il sostegno è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie quando si muovono.

Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Come membro del Quality Control (QC), si è responsabili per l'implementazione pratica di una vasta gamma di metodi biochimici per caratterizzare principi attivi anticorpi complessi e altamente attivi (ma anche altre biomolecole) sotto GMP. I biocongiurati sono una classe innovativa di principi attivi in cui le alte speranze sono poste nella terapia del cancro, tra gli altri.

Il team di biochimica lavora principalmente con biocongiunti e appartiene al dipartimento di QC-Biologia. Per rafforzare la nostra squadra di laboratorio, stiamo cercando uno scienziato junior.

Cosa ti offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre agli stipendi competitivi, troverete una vasta gamma di lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. A seconda della posizione, queste prestazioni possono includere assegni familiari, assistenza all'infanzia, sconti per le imprese locali e le attrazioni, indennità di viaggio e pasti sovvenzionati.

I loro compiti:

• Applicazione indipendente di tecniche analitiche biochimiche con focus su ELISA, elettroforesi gel e analisi rDNA.

• Collaborazione nello sviluppo dei metodi, nell'implementazione, nel trasferimento e nella convalida, nonché nella valutazione dei dati e della soluzione delle domande analitiche, soprattutto nel campo dei saggi basati sulle cellule.

• Pianificazione, coordinamento e attuazione dei test di approvazione nonché supporto tecnico per le questioni analitiche e tecniche nell'ambiente GMP.

• Trattamento indipendente di deviazioni, richieste di cambiamento e indagini nel quadro dei requisiti normativi.

• Valutazione e interpretazione dei dati analitici e preparazione di relazioni e presentazioni scientifiche.

• Scrivere, controllare e rilasciare documenti pertinenti alla qualità per garantire il rispetto dei requisiti legali e interni.

• Realizzazione autonoma dei compiti assegnati nell'ambito di studi e progetti con particolare attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza e all'aderenza delle scadenze.

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Laurea completa in scienze (BSc o superiore) in biologia, biochimica, chimica o un campo correlato

• Idealmente, prima esperienza professionale nel controllo della qualità o nell'analisi dei biofarmaci, preferibilmente nell'ambiente GMP regolamentato

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

• Assumere responsabilità e contribuire attivamente competenze professionali al team

• Sensibilizzazione, iniziativa e impegno di alta qualità

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura e buona conoscenza dell'inglese

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Visp (Switzerland)

If necessary, support is available for eligible candidates and their families when moving.

Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

As a member of Quality Control (QC), you are responsible for the practical implementation of a wide range of biochemical methods for characterizing complex and highly active conjugated antibody active ingredients (but also other biomolecules) under GMP. The bioconjugates are an innovative class of active ingredients in which high hopes are placed in cancer therapy, among others.

The biochemistry team works mainly with bioconjugates and belongs to the QC-Biology department. To strengthen our laboratory team, we are looking for a junior scientist.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to competitive salaries, you will find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits. Depending on location, these benefits may include family allowances, childcare assistance, discounts for local businesses and attractions, travel allowances, and subsidized meals.

Their tasks:

• Independent application of biochemical analytical techniques with focus on ELISA, gel electrophoresis and rDNA analysis.

• Collaboration in method development, implementation, transfer and validation as well as in the evaluation of data and solution of analytical questions – especially in the field of cell-based assays.

• Planning, coordination and implementation of approval tests as well as technical support for analytical and technical issues in the GMP environment.

• Independent processing of deviations, change requests and investigations within the framework of regulatory requirements.

• Evaluation and interpretation of analytical data and preparation of scientific reports and presentations.

• Writing, checking and releasing quality-relevant documents to ensure compliance with legal and internal requirements.

• Self-responsible implementation of the assigned tasks within the framework of studies and projects with focus on quality, security and adherence to deadlines.

Your requirement profile:

• Completed science degree (BSc or higher) in biology, biochemistry, chemistry or a related field

• Ideally, first professional experience in the quality control or analysis of biopharmaceuticals, preferably in the regulated GMP environment

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method

• Assuming responsibility and actively contributing professional expertise to the team

• High quality awareness, initiative and commitment

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing and good knowledge of English

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a priority and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges and use their creativity to develop new ideas for complex problems. Together we make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This offers them the certainty and satisfaction of really making a difference with their own work.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. • Diplôme scientifique (BSc ou supérieur) en biologie, biochimie, chimie ou domaine connexe

• Idéalement, première expérience professionnelle dans le contrôle ou l'analyse de la qualité des produits biopharmaceutiques, de préférence dans l'environnement réglementé des BPF

• Méthode de travail indépendante, structurée et axée sur les solutions

• Sensibilisation, initiative et engagement de haute qualité

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture et bonne connaissance de l'anglais

Cela leur offre la certitude et la satisfaction de faire vraiment une différence avec leur propre travail.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

In this role, you will contribute to robust monitoring activities by evaluating complex data, improving processes, and supporting compliance in a GMP‑regulated environment. You will work closely with cross‑functional partners and play an active role in inspections and continuous improvement initiatives.

What you will get:

• An agile scientific career in a dynamic, GMP‑regulated environment.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace that values collaboration and accountability.

• Compensation programs that recognize performance and technical expertise.

• Opportunities to deepen your expertise and take ownership of impactful projects.

• Exposure to cross‑functional collaboration and regulatory interactions.

• A supportive culture that encourages continuous improvement and learning.

• Competitive local benefits.

Benefits in Visp

What you will do:

• You collect, evaluate, and summarize monitoring data using MODA, LIMS, and digital analysis tools.

• You document GMP‑relevant activities and lead investigations of alert or action level excursions.

• You drive root‑cause investigations and align corrective actions with key stakeholders.

• You create, review, and approve DMS documents to ensure accuracy and compliance.

• You improve monitoring processes to enhance data quality, efficiency, and robustness.

• You implement monitoring updates and manage MODA‑related changes under change control.

• You represent the team during inspections, audits, and customer visits with confidence.

What we are looking for:

• You hold a degree in life sciences or a related scientific field.

• You bring around two years of relevant experience in a GMP‑regulated environment.

• Experience in environmental monitoring and/or microbiology is an advantage.

• You have strong digital skills, including Microsoft Office and documentation systems.

• Knowledge of regulatory requirements, pharmacopoeias, and EU Annex 1 is ideal but not required.

• You communicate confidently in English; German skills are a plus.

• You work independently and bring a proactive, detail‑oriented, solution‑focused mindset.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con partner interfunzionali e svolgere un ruolo attivo nelle ispezioni e nelle iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera scientifica agile in un ambiente dinamico e regolamentato da GMP.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico che valorizza la collaborazione e la responsabilità.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono prestazioni e competenze tecniche.

• Opportunità per approfondire la vostra competenza e prendere la proprietà di progetti impattanti.

• Esposizione alla collaborazione interfunzionale e alle interazioni normative.

• Una cultura solidale che incoraggia il continuo miglioramento e l'apprendimento.

• Vantaggi locali competitivi.

Vantaggi in Visp

Cosa farai:

• Raccogli, valuta e riassume i dati di monitoraggio utilizzando strumenti di analisi MODA, LIMS e digitale.

• L'utente documenta le attività di GMP-relevant e conduce indagini sulle escursioni a livello di allarme o di azione.

• Si guida root-cause indagini e allineare le azioni correttive con i principali stakeholder.

• Creare, rivedere e approvare documenti DMS per garantire l'accuratezza e la conformità.

• Migliora i processi di monitoraggio per migliorare la qualità dei dati, l'efficienza e la robustezza.

• Attui gli aggiornamenti di monitoraggio e gestisci le modifiche relative a MODA sotto il controllo dei cambiamenti.

• Lei rappresenta il team durante le ispezioni, gli audit e le visite dei clienti con fiducia.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Hai una laurea in scienze della vita o in un campo scientifico correlato.

• Porti circa due anni di esperienza rilevante in un ambiente GMP-regolato.

• L'esperienza nel monitoraggio ambientale e/o microbiologia è un vantaggio.

• Hai forti competenze digitali, tra cui Microsoft Office e sistemi di documentazione.

• La conoscenza dei requisiti normativi, delle farmacopea e dell'allegato 1 dell'UE è ideale ma non è richiesta.

• Si comunica con fiducia in inglese; le competenze tedesche sono un plus.

• Si lavora in modo indipendente e portare una mentalità proattiva, orientata al dettaglio, orientata alla soluzione.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

jobs.description:
MSAT Material Management & Single-Use Systems Expert

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
Join Lonza's MSAT team in Visp and play a critical role in shaping the future of biopharmaceutical manufacturing through innovative material management strategies and advanced single-use technologies. This role offers the opportunity to influence global manufacturing operations, improve supply chain resilience, and support the delivery of life-changing therapies to patients worldwide.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• The opportunity to work on cutting-edge biopharmaceutical manufacturing technologies.

• Exposure to global manufacturing networks and cross-functional collaboration.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• A comprehensive range of benefits tailored to Switzerland and your role.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: Employee Benefits | Lonza

What you will do:

• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Raw Materials and Single-Use Systems within MSAT Microbial.

• Lead risk assessments and evaluate material impact on process performance, product quality, and supply continuity.

• Drive material-related investigations, deviations, CAPAs, and change controls in compliance with GMP requirements.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, QA, QC, Supply Chain, Engineering, Process Development, and external suppliers to resolve technical challenges.

• Support material lifecycle management, supplier management, and implementation of mitigation strategies to ensure manufacturing reliability.

• Provide technical leadership for material qualification, optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Drive standardization and harmonization of material management and single-use system practices in alignment with local and global teams, ensuring consistent application of best practices across the organization.

• Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, and GMP compliance activities.

What we are looking for:

• Master's degree or PhD in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, process support, material management, or related GMP-regulated environments.

• Strong expertise in Raw Materials, Single-Use Systems, supplier management, and lifecycle management.

• Profound understanding of GMP requirements, risk management methodologies, deviations, CAPAs, and change control processes.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving complex technical investigations.

• Ability to lead and influence cross-functional stakeholders without formal line authority, driving alignment, standardization, and execution of material management and single-use system initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with internal and external partners.

• Ability to balance scientific, operational, quality, and business requirements in decision making.

• Structured, solution-oriented, and proactive working style.

• Fluency in English; German is considered an advantage.

• Open-minded, collaborative, and passionate about driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
MSAT Gestione dei materiali e esperto di sistemi a singolo utilizzo

Ubicazione: Visp, Svizzera

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.
Unisciti al team MSAT di Lonza a Visp e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione del futuro della produzione biofarmaceutica attraverso strategie di gestione dei materiali innovative e tecnologie di single-use avanzate. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di influenzare le operazioni di produzione globali, migliorare la resilienza della supply chain e sostenere la consegna di terapie che cambiano la vita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Questo ruolo si basa principalmente sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• L'opportunità di lavorare sulle tecnologie di produzione biofarmaceutica all'avanguardia.

• Esposizione a reti di produzione globali e collaborazione interfunzionale.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Una gamma completa di vantaggi su misura per la Svizzera e il tuo ruolo.

L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi globali si trova qui: Vantaggi del dipendente | Lonza

Cosa farai:

• Agire come soggetto esperto di materia (SME) per materie prime e sistemi mono-uso all'interno di MSAT Microbial.

• Analisi del rischio di piombo e valutazione dell'impatto materiale sulle prestazioni del processo, sulla qualità del prodotto e sulla continuità dell'offerta.

• Guidare indagini, deviazioni, CAPAs e modificare i controlli in conformità ai requisiti GMP.

• Collaborare interfunzionalmente con Manufacturing, QA, QC, Supply Chain, Engineering, Process Development e fornitori esterni per risolvere le sfide tecniche.

• Supporta la gestione del ciclo di vita materiale, la gestione dei fornitori e l'implementazione di strategie di mitigazione per garantire affidabilità di produzione.

• Fornire leadership tecnica per le iniziative di qualificazione, ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo.

• Guidare la standardizzazione e l'armonizzazione delle pratiche di gestione dei materiali e del sistema di uso singolo in allineamento con i team locali e globali, garantendo un'applicazione coerente delle migliori pratiche in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Sostenere le ispezioni regolamentari, le verifiche dei clienti e le attività di conformità GMP.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Biotecnologia, Biochimica, Ingegneria Chimica, Scienze della Vita, o una disciplina correlata.

• Ampia esperienza nella produzione biofarmaceutica, nel supporto di processo, nella gestione dei materiali o negli ambienti regolamentati GMP.

• Forte competenza in materia di materie prime, sistemi a singolo utilizzo, gestione dei fornitori e gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Compresa comprensione dei requisiti GMP, metodologie di gestione dei rischi, deviazioni, CAPAs e processi di controllo dei cambiamenti.

• Sperimenta i principali team interfunzionali e guida complesse indagini tecniche.

• Capacità di guidare e influenzare gli stakeholder interfunzionali senza autorità di linea formale, allineamento di guida, standardizzazione, e l'esecuzione delle iniziative di gestione dei materiali e di sistema di uso singolo.

• Forte capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder con partner interni ed esterni.

• Capacità di bilanciare i requisiti scientifici, operativi, di qualità e aziendali nel processo decisionale.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientato alla soluzione e proattivo.

• Fluenza in inglese; il tedesco è considerato un vantaggio.

• Open-minded, collaborativo e appassionato di guidare l'eccellenza operativa e il miglioramento continuo.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland. Eligible applicants and their families will be assisted in moving if needed.

The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing continuously and for our Biologics organization we are currently looking for several bioprocess engineers/biotechnologists/chemists (m/f/d) for pharmaceutical production. In this role, you are responsible for handling production campaigns in the production plant for the production of bioconjugate PCP (Potent Compound Production).

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Our full list of local benefits can be found below:

• Benefits in Visp

Their tasks:

• As a bioprocess engineer/biotechnologist/chemist (f/m/d), you are responsible for the correct implementation of production campaigns according to cGMP guidelines

• Review of the risk analysis and implementation of the resulting measures

• Ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, fixing problems, troubleshooting manufacturing plants, as well as proposing solutions

• Complete documentation of processes and process know-how, as well as complete GMP documentation

• Preparation of campaign reports and participation in Annual Product Review’s

• Continuous improvement possibilities of the processes, plants and processes, in cooperation with various project teams such as R&D, MSAT to increase process efficiency and economic use of the plants

• Responsible for the training of employees in the assigned products (campaign training), as well as co-responsibility for the training of employees, in cross-project topics (quarterly training, special topics) and in daily operations

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's / Master's degree (uni / FH) or doctorate - preferably in biotechnology, biochemistry, chemistry or the like.

• First professional experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnological or industrial production desirable

• Flowing knowledge of German and English

• Good GMP understanding

• Team and leadership skills, as well as very good communication skills

• Cross-functional, structured and focused way of working

• Talent for organization, proactivity and openness to new ideas and suggestions

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Join Lonza and help shape the future of bioconjugation through digital innovation.  As a key partner to scientific teams, you will connect science, data, AI, and technology to accelerate development, improve decision-making, and deliver measurable business value across Advanced Synthesis.

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• PhD in Chemistry, Bioconjugation, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Computational Sciences, or  a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CDMO, CRO, or related scientific environments.

• Experience applying digital, data science, computational, or AI-driven approaches to research and development challenges.

• Proven ability to translate scientific needs into scalable digital products, capabilities, or solutions.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Experience with digital transformation, scientific workflow digitalization, analytics, AI/ML, or innovation strategy is  advantageous.

Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Become part of our team as a Manufacturing Specialist 4-layer 80-100% (m/f/d) and actively support our microbial production campaigns with your expertise.
In this versatile role, you accompany fermentation and purification campaigns organizationally and technically, ensure a safe and efficient production process and work closely with different specialist areas.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Their tasks:

• Ensuring smooth processes through organisational and technical support of fermentation and purification campaigns – with a focus on quality, efficiency and safety

• Monitoring and controlling planned process steps during upstream (fermentation) and downstream phases

• Active participation in microbial production processes (e.g. fermentation, cell harvesting, purification) in compliance with the applicable cGMP guidelines – including troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous process optimization

• Contribute to risk assessments and implement defined safety and quality measures

• Professional support and knowledge transfer of operators on plants and standardized processes

• Ensuring, reviewing and continuous optimization of manufacturing regulations, SOPs and batch documentation

Your requirement profile:

• Completed degree (Bachelor/Master) in Biotechnology, Microbiology or Bio-/Chemical Engineering

• Experience in microbial production processes (especially fermentation and/or purification) is advantageous

• GMP knowledge is desirable – or the willingness to acquire it

• Readiness to work in the flexible 4-shift system

• Very good knowledge of German is required; English skills are beneficial

• Teamwork, communication strength and a structured, solution-oriented way of working – They actively contribute their ideas

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
