Werde Teil unseres Engineering‑Teams als Anlagetechniker Kleingeräte 80-100% (m/w/d) in Visp.
In dieser Rolle stellst du sicher, dass alle Kleingeräte im Bereich BPMP1P2 & BPMSS fachgerecht beschafft, qualifiziert und gewartet werden. Mit deinem Einsatz gewährleistest du die GMP‑Konformität, hältst das technische Know‑how aktuell und sorgst gemeinsam mit Technik, Lieferanten und Betrieb für ein reibungslos funktionierendes Produktionsumfeld.

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Deine Aufgaben:

• Sicherstellung der regelkonformen Verfügbarkeit sämtlicher Kleingeräte innerhalb des zugewiesenen Bereichs

• Durchführung von Requalifizierungs-, Revalidierungsarbeiten sowie Temperatur-Mappings

• Bearbeitung der anfallenden Störmeldungen und Sicherstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft der Kleingeräte inklusive Waschmaschinen und Autoklaven

• Planung, Vorbereitung und Koordination Wartungsarbeiten

• Zuständig für das Änderungs- und Abweichungswesen (CR, DR, CAPA) nach GMP und Durchführung der geforderten Risikoanalysen

• Erstellung und Pflege von Arbeitsvorschriften (SOPs)

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von cGMP- und regulatorischen Anforderungen

• Durchführung von Trainings sowie Sicherstellung des Wissensstands des Bedienpersonals

• Unterstützung bei Audits und Inspektionen (Auditbereitschaft sicherstellen)

• Mitarbeit bei der Überwachung von Budget (Unterhalt, Investitionen, Anpassungen)

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufslehre (idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker)

• Berufserfahrung in der Produktion und Instandhaltung von Maschinen und Geräten bevorzugt in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld der Pharma- oder Biotechindustrie

• Solide Kenntnisse in GMP, SAP und Microsoft Anwendungen (Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Sharepoint, Excel, etc.)

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten; starker Teamplayer; sehr guter Kommunikationsstil

• Strukturiertes, fokussiertes und sehr gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten

• Deutsch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift); Englisch (gute Kenntnisse)

Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Du bereit bist, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, dich an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Se necessario, i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie saranno assistiti in movimento.

Diventa parte del nostro team di ingegneria come tecnico di investimento piccole attrezzature BPMP1P2 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp.
In questo ruolo, si assicura che tutte le piccole attrezzature nella zona di BPMP1P2 sia professionalmente procurato, qualificato e mantenuto. Con il vostro utilizzo, assicurate la conformità GMP, tenete il know-how tecnico aggiornato e insieme alla tecnologia, ai fornitori e alle operazioni garantiscono un ambiente di produzione perfettamente funzionante.

Cosa ti offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e la cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi benefici nelle aree di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali è disponibile anche su: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

I vostri compiti:

• Garantire la conformità di tutti i piccoli dispositivi all'interno della gamma assegnata

• Eseguire la riqualificazione, il lavoro di rivalutazione e la mappatura della temperatura

• Elaborazione dei messaggi di errore che ne risultano e garanzia della disponibilità operativa di piccoli dispositivi tra cui lavatrici e autoclavi

• Pianificazione, preparazione e coordinamento dei lavori di manutenzione

• Responsabile per il cambiamento e la deviazione (CR, DR, CAPA) secondo GMP e l'esecuzione delle analisi di rischio richieste

• Preparazione e manutenzione dei regolamenti sul lavoro (SOP)

• Garantire la conformità a cGMP e requisiti normativi

• Condurre la formazione e garantire il livello di conoscenza degli operatori

• Supporto per audit e ispezioni (assicurare la disponibilità di audit)

• Cooperazione nel controllo del bilancio (manutenzione, investimenti, adeguamenti)

Il tuo profilo:

• Apprendistato tecnico completo (probabilmente con formazione continua come tecnico)

• Esperienza professionale nella produzione e manutenzione di macchine e attrezzature preferite in un ambiente GMP-regolato del settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico

• Conoscenza solida delle applicazioni GMP, SAP e Microsoft (Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Sharepoint, Excel, ecc.)

• lavoro autonomo e flessibile; giocatori di squadra forti; Molto buono stile di comunicazione

• Comportamento di lavoro strutturato, focalizzato e molto ben organizzato

• tedesco (traboccante in parola e scrittura); inglese (buona conoscenza)

Informazioni su Lonza:

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è esattamente ciò che vogliamo che tu condivida.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora

descriptionByLocale.en:
Where necessary, eligible candidates and their families will be assisted in moving.

Become part of our engineering team as an investment technician small equipment BPMP1P2 80-100% (m/f/d) in Visp.
In this role, you ensure that all small equipment in the area of BPMP1P2 is professionally procured, qualified and maintained. With your use, you ensure GMP compliance, keep the technical know-how up-to-date and together with technology, suppliers and operations ensure a smoothly functioning production environment.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your tasks:

• Ensuring the compliance of all small devices within the allocated range

• Performing requalification, revalidation work and temperature mapping

• Processing of the resulting fault messages and ensuring the operational readiness of small devices including washing machines and autoclaves

• Planning, preparation and coordination of maintenance work

• Responsible for change and deviation (CR, DR, CAPA) according to GMP and carrying out the required risk analyses

• Preparation and maintenance of labour regulations (SOPs)

• Ensuring compliance with cGMP and regulatory requirements

• Conducting training and ensuring the level of knowledge of operators

• Support for audits and inspections (ensure audit readiness)

• Cooperation in monitoring budget (maintenance, investments, adjustments)

Your profile:

• Completed technical apprenticeship (ideally with further training as a technician)

• Professional experience in the production and maintenance of machines and equipment preferred in a GMP-regulated environment of the pharmaceutical or biotech industry

• Solid knowledge of GMP, SAP and Microsoft applications (Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Sharepoint, Excel, etc.)

• self-employed and flexible working; strong team players; Very good communication style

• Structured, focused and very well organized work behavior

• German (flowing in word and writing); English (good knowledge)

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s exactly what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de projet principal de l'IE&C TI/OT 80-100% (m/f/j)

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Engineering team in Visp as an EI&C MES Application Manager 80-100% (m/f/d) and drive the evolution of our MES landscape across its full lifecycle. In this role, you’ll shape digital manufacturing by leading MES projects, strengthening system standards, and ensuring GMP‑compliant, high‑impact system performance.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What you’ll do:

• Execute and lead MES projects across all lifecycle phases, including requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

• Maintain, optimize, and further develop MES standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and alignment with site and global guidelines.

• Ensure reliable operation, enhancement, and updating of MES systems, recognizing their direct impact on production processes and GMP‑compliant documentation.

• Collaborate closely with Operations, QA, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless system integration and high system availability.

• Analyze and improve MES‑related workflows, identifying opportunities for digitalization, efficiency gains, and data integrity improvements.

• Coordinate and manage external partners and vendors involved in MES or OT‑related project and support activities.

• Ensure GMP‑compliant execution of all MES and OT activities, including documentation, change control, and validation readiness.

What we are looking for:

• Completed university degree in Computer Science, Industrial IT/OT, Automation Engineering, or a related field (Bachelor level or higher).

• Significant professional experience in IT/OT, MES, or automation‑related engineering roles within a regulated environment.

• Solid understanding of GMP requirements and experience working with validated production or automation systems.

• Responsibility for the MES lifecycle, including system operation, enhancements, release management, and interface coordination.

• Strong knowledge of OT networks, virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware), system architectures, and basic cybersecurity principles.

• Fluent German or English (minimum B2 level) for effective collaboration with local and global stakeholders.

• Structured, independent working style with strong communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Willingness to participate in on‑call duty (Pikettdienst) 2-3 times per year.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza and help shape the future of Advanced Synthesis through AI, machine learning, and data science. This strategic role combines scientific expertise, advanced analytics, and digital innovation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, and deliver business impact across the organization.

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• The opportunity to shape and scale AI/ML and Data Science capabilities within a global organization.

• Leadership opportunities through mentoring, capability building, and strategic influence.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location (Visp, Basel, or Oss). The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead the application of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and data science solutions to address high-value scientific and operational challenges.

• Partner with R&D scientists and Advanced Synthesis stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable digital solutions.

• Design and implement predictive models, optimization tools, and decision-support systems that improve scientific outcomes and operational efficiency.

• Collaborate with data engineering, digital, and technical teams to deliver robust end-to-end solutions from concept through deployment.

• Drive innovation by evaluating and introducing emerging AI/ML methodologies, technologies, and best practices.

• Influence strategic priorities and establish scalable standards, frameworks, and ways of working across Data Science & Modelling initiatives.

• Mentor colleagues and contribute to the growth of digital capabilities and future team development.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Bioconjugation, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Solid industry experience in data science, AI/ML, computational sciences, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, or related fields within pharma, biotech, CDMO, or similar environments.

• Advanced expertise in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data science with a track record of delivering business impact.

• Strong programming skills in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.

• Experience developing end-to-end data science solutions from exploration and modelling through deployment and adoption.

• Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence senior leaders.

• Experience in bioconjugation, MLOps, digital transformation, or scientific workflow optimization is highly desirable.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza and help shape the future of Advanced Synthesis through AI, machine learning, and data science. This strategic role combines scientific expertise, advanced analytics, and digital innovation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, and deliver business impact across the organization.

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• The opportunity to shape and scale AI/ML and Data Science capabilities within a global organization.

• Leadership opportunities through mentoring, capability building, and strategic influence.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location (Visp, Basel, or Oss). The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead the application of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and data science solutions to address high-value scientific and operational challenges.

• Partner with R&D scientists and Advanced Synthesis stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable digital solutions.

• Design and implement predictive models, optimization tools, and decision-support systems that improve scientific outcomes and operational efficiency.

• Collaborate with data engineering, digital, and technical teams to deliver robust end-to-end solutions from concept through deployment.

• Drive innovation by evaluating and introducing emerging AI/ML methodologies, technologies, and best practices.

• Influence strategic priorities and establish scalable standards, frameworks, and ways of working across Data Science & Modelling initiatives.

• Mentor colleagues and contribute to the growth of digital capabilities and future team development.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Bioconjugation, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Solid industry experience in data science, AI/ML, computational sciences, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, or related fields within pharma, biotech, CDMO, or similar environments.

• Advanced expertise in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data science with a track record of delivering business impact.

• Strong programming skills in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.

• Experience developing end-to-end data science solutions from exploration and modelling through deployment and adoption.

• Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence senior leaders.

• Experience in bioconjugation, MLOps, digital transformation, or scientific workflow optimization is highly desirable.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician - Analytical Development Bioconjugates 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lonza als führender Auftragshersteller von Antikörper Wirkstoff Konjugate (ADCs) besitzt langjährige Erfahrungen am Standort Visp für die klinischen und kommerzielle Produktion dieser aufstrebenden Klasse von Medikamenten. Die Erforschung und Herstellung von ADCs und anderen Biokonjugaten befinden sich weltweit in einer starken Wachstumsphase und somit auch in unserem Unternehmen, weshalb wir nach einen neuen und engagierten Laboratory Technician suchen, um unser Team Analytische Entwicklung  am Standort Visp zu verstärken.

Als Mitglied unserer Abteilung bist Du an der Entwicklung, Optimierung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden für die prozessbegleitende Analytik und Freigabe von Biokonjugaten beteiligt. Du arbeitest nach ISO- und GMP Qualitätsrichtlinien, planst und bearbeitest eigenverantwortlich die dir zugeteilten Analysenaufträge und erstellst die dazugehörige Dokumentation.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Deine Aufgaben:

• Entwicklung, Optimierung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden wie zum Beispiel RP-, SE- und IEX-HPLC, icIEF, CE-SDS, UV/VIS-Spektroskopie und ELISA

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As a CSV Engineer (m/f/d) you will be responsible for the generation and execution of the validation of the computerized systems on process engineering equipment and facilities, including MES. You are responsible to follow the planning and implementation of CSV activities resulting from projects and plant adaptations during the system life cycle of the plants, as well as make a contribution to the ongoing optimization of processes, facilities and internal procedures.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What you will do:

• Prepare commissioning and validation documents for new systems, and supervise conversion, expansion, and new construction projects. This includes CSV activities for critical systems in new construction projects and SLC support for all systems post debut.

• Supervise deviations, changes (GEP and GMP), and CAPAs, ensuring strict adherence to protocols.

• Coordinate CSV executions with internal groups, as well as external service providers and suppliers, to strictly ensure seamless integration.

• Present CSV documents during audits and inspections, showcasing our world-class standards.

• Schedule and report CSV activities, maintaining a flawless record of progress and outcomes.

• Align CSV strategy with QA CSV for all Biologics scope, showcasing our dedication to high standards.

• Contribute to the review and continuous amelioration of all CSV documents, ensuring ongoing optimization and success.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor / Master / Diploma from a technical school (HF) / university of applied sciences (FH) or university in a technical field or equivalent experience, showcasing your solid educational foundation.

• Significant experience in a regulated environment with regard to Computerized System Validation (CSV), demonstrating your proven expertise.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and Delta-V, essential for your successful implementation of tasks.

• Knowledge of KNEAT, COMOS (plant engineering software solution), DMS, TrackWise, and SAP is an advantage, improving your ability to compete in our ambitious environment.

• Proficient in English, with German language skills being advantageous, enabling you to collaborate effectively in our diverse team.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. Spread across 30+ sites and five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity shape what we achieve and how we achieve it. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Diese Rolle basiert in erster Linie auf der Website. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteile erwarten. Unsere vollständige Liste der maßgeschneiderten lokalen Vorteile in Visp finden Sie unter 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Was Sie tun werden:

• Bereiten Sie Inbetriebnahme- und Validierungsdokumente für neue Systeme vor und überwachen Sie Umbau-, Erweiterungs- und Neubauprojekte. Dazu gehören CSV-Aktivitäten für kritische Systeme in Neubauprojekten und SLC-Unterstützung für alle Systeme nach dem Debüt.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie Abweichungen, Änderungen (GEP und GMP) und CAPAs, um eine strikte Einhaltung der Protokolle zu gewährleisten.

• Koordinieren Sie CSV-Ausführungen mit internen Gruppen sowie externen Dienstleistern und Lieferanten, um eine nahtlose Integration zu gewährleisten.

• Präsentieren Sie CSV-Dokumente während Audits und Inspektionen und präsentieren Sie unsere Weltklasse-Standards.

Vous êtes responsable de suivre la planification et la mise en œuvre des activités CSV résultant de projets et d'adaptations d'usines pendant le cycle de vie du système des usines, ainsi que d'apporter une contribution à l'optimisation continue des processus, des installations et des procédures internes.

Ce rôle est principalement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez:

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

• En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. Notre liste complète des prestations locales sur mesure à Visp se trouve sur 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Ce que vous ferez :

• Préparer des documents de mise en service et de validation pour les nouveaux systèmes et superviser les projets de conversion, d'expansion et de construction. Cela inclut les activités du CSV pour les systèmes critiques dans les nouveaux projets de construction et le soutien SLC pour tous les systèmes après les débuts.

• Superviser les déviations, les changements (GEP et GMP) et les APC, en veillant au strict respect des protocoles.

• Coordonner les exécutions du CSV avec les groupes internes, ainsi qu'avec les fournisseurs et fournisseurs de services externes, afin d'assurer strictement une intégration transparente.

• Présentez les documents du CSV lors des vérifications et des inspections, en mettant en valeur nos normes de calibre mondial.

• Planifier et rapporter les activités du CSV, en tenant un registre impeccable des progrès et des résultats.

• Aligner la stratégie CSV avec le CSV de l'AQ pour tous les produits biologiques, en montrant notre dévouement à des normes élevées.

• Contribuer à l'examen et à l'amélioration continue de tous les documents du CSV, en assurant l'optimisation continue et le succès.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Baccalauréat / Master / Diplôme d'une école technique (HF) / université des sciences appliquées (FH) ou université dans un domaine technique ou une expérience équivalente, mettant en valeur votre solide fondation éducative.

• Expérience significative dans un environnement réglementé en ce qui concerne la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV), démontrant votre expertise éprouvée.

• Bonne connaissance de Microsoft Office et Delta-V, essentielle à votre mise en œuvre réussie des tâches.

• Connaissance de KNEAT, COMOS (solution logicielle d'ingénierie végétale), DMS, TrackWise et SAP est un avantage, améliorant votre capacité à rivaliser dans notre environnement ambitieux.

• Compétence en anglais, avec des compétences linguistiques en allemand étant avantageuses, vous permettant de collaborer efficacement dans notre équipe diversifiée.

À propos de Lonza :

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Répartis sur plus de 30 sites et cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité façonnent ce que nous accomplissons et comment nous le faisons. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. À Lonza, nous offrons des possibilités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats qualifiés indépendamment de la race, de la religion, de la couleur, de l'origine nationale, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité de genre, de l'âge, du handicap, du statut de vétéran ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

jobs.title: E2E Process Engineer
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

As an E2E Process Engineer, you will support strategic capital projects across the ADS Platform, collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop and implement engineering and operational solutions that ensure successful project delivery and operational readiness.

What you will do:

• Support delivery of strategic capital investment programs across the ADS Platform.

• Develop project charters, business requirements, scopes, and execution strategies.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams to integrate project deliverables effectively.

• Maintain project schedules, governance frameworks, and progress reporting.

• Prepare business cases, funding approvals, and portfolio decision materials.

• Lead technical evaluations, process engineering activities, and operational readiness initiatives.

• Support risk, change, cost, schedule, and stakeholder management to ensure successful project delivery.

What we are looking for:

• Master’s degree in Chemical, Process, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related field.

• Fluent in English and German.

• Experience in pharmaceutical, chemical, or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.

• Strong knowledge of process engineering, facility design, GMP operations, and capital project execution.

• Understanding of the full project lifecycle, from design through start-up and operational readiness.

• Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

• Proactive problem-solver with the ability to translate strategic objectives into practical engineering solutions.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi su misura locali può anche essere trovato di seguito.

In qualità di E2E Process Engineer, supporterai progetti strategici di capitale attraverso la piattaforma ADS, collaborando con team interfunzionali per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni ingegneristiche e operative che garantiscano il successo della consegna del progetto e la disponibilità operativa.

Cosa farai:

• Supporta la fornitura di programmi di investimento di capitale strategico attraverso la piattaforma ADS.

• Sviluppare le carte di progetto, i requisiti aziendali, gli ambiti e le strategie di esecuzione.

• Coordinate i team interfunzionali per integrare efficacemente i progetti consegnabili.

• Mantenere i programmi di progetto, i quadri di governance e la reportistica sui progressi.

• Preparare casi aziendali, approvazioni di finanziamento e materiali decisionali di portafoglio.

• Condurre valutazioni tecniche, attività di ingegneria dei processi e iniziative di prontezza operativa.

• Rischio di supporto, cambiamento, costo, programma e gestione delle parti interessate per garantire la consegna di progetti di successo.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea magistrale in chimica, processo, ingegneria farmaceutica, o un campo correlato.

• Fluente in inglese e tedesco.

• Esperienza in ambienti di produzione farmaceutici, chimici o di altro tipo GMP.

• Forte conoscenza di ingegneria di processo, progettazione di impianti, operazioni GMP e esecuzione di progetto di capitale.

• Comprensione del ciclo di vita del progetto completo, dalla progettazione all'avvio e alla prontezza operativa.

• Eccellente analitica, comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e competenze organizzative.

• Problema-solver attivo con la capacità di tradurre obiettivi strategici in soluzioni di ingegneria pratica.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

To strengthen our engineering & maintenance team at the Visp site, we are looking for an electrical, measurement and control (EMR) engineer. You are responsible for maintenance as well as for projects in mono- or multi-product plants.

This is what we offer you:

• An agile career and dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. All global services can be found here: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

• Technical project management or participation in small projects and investment projects

• Professional planning, preparation and coordination of EMR maintenance, including internal and external partners

• Order allocation, capacity planning, maintenance of reporting in SAP and ensuring plant availability

• Collaboration in the interdisciplinary engineering team, support of operations management

• Compliance with safety, quality, hygiene and environmental standards

• Continuous optimization of plants, processes and maintenance processes, cooperation in risk analysis

• Maintenance of plant documentation in SAP/COMOS, flowchart maintenance

• Budget monitoring for projects, investments and maintenance

Your profile:

• Completed Technical School (HF), Bachelor (FH) or Master (ETH) in Electrical, Automation or Systems Engineering

• Experience in EMR maintenance/projects in industry is beneficial

• Knowledge of SAP/COMOS/DeltaV/Modicon/Cimplicity beneficial, good office knowledge

• German fluent, English beneficial

• Independent, flexible, capable of teamwork, structured and organized

• Reliable, resilient, solution-oriented, open to new ideas and highly motivated

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honor, but also a great responsibility. Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges and use their creativity to develop new ideas for complex problems. Ready to help shape the future of life sciences? Then apply now!

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The Material Management Analyst is:

• responsible to perform all duties to ensure the performance of the team is on track and tasks are completed.

• responsible to liaise with all key functions to ensure timely updates and analysis to materials.

• responsible of execution of key tasks to support Lonza’s inventory and optimization initiatives. Ensure effective management of the material portfolio and its lifecycle control.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

Benefits in Visp: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group
ag/d/9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What you will do:

• Support the Material Management Head in coordinating the MRP team, ensuring alignment on key priorities and processes.

• Generate and oversee material-related KPIs, implementing corrective actions and improvements to enhance material availability visibility.

• Manage the raw material portfolio of the supply chain in planning systems, including lifecycle control, and execution of large-scale master data updates and monitoring of the created Planning Orders, Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders.

• Reporting of Purchase Order related activities to external Audit Companies.

• Provide expertise in the management of specialized material categories.

• Participates in supply chain development initiatives brining material management expertise. Executes material related projects.

• SAP & AFI Key User – primary reference for system expertise and user support

• Material coverage analysis for Visp site – defines next steps and future strategy (projects supported by Lonza EC Board Level)

• Core Team Member, key role with analyzing current processes and making a significant contribution to the restructuring the Supply Chain Organization in Visp (MRP & MPL)

• Responsible for (SMOG) Scrapping Approval Workflows. Initiating, track and trace – ensuring accurate inventory level and timeliness for financial improvements for all 3 business platforms

• Preparing the reports for the MRPs to check SMOG items for monthly accurate SMOG submission.

• Preparing and submitting the monthly file for departments to check SMOG Liability to customer.

• Core Team Member - Value Stream Mapping Material Management, supporting process optimization and improvement

• Maintaining and analyzing safety stock levels for the Visp site to ensure optimal inventory availability/ Replenishment Policy

• Supporting the Head of Supply Chain by preparing and analyzing multiple reports for decision-making

• Providing cross-departmental support (QC, Plant Logistics, SC) with ad-hoc reports and analysis

• Training and onboarding new employees on SAP usage, ensuring knowledge transfer and faster integration

What we are looking for:
·       Degree or equivalent experience in SCM, Procurement or any relevant field
·       CPIM, APICS Certification would be desired
·       Min. of 5 years’ experience as a Material Requirement Planner or Analyst
·       Experience in SCM, Materials Planning/Scheduling and/or Purchasing
·       Good knowledge of SAP, especially MM and MS Office (Excel, Powerpoint), PowerBI
·       Especially Presentation and Data Analytical skills are required.
·       Good communication and presentation skills
·       Fluency in English is required. German desired
·       Strong Teammate and able to work across cross-functional teams

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply!

Cosa farai:

• Generare e supervisionare i KPI relativi ai materiali, implementando azioni correttive e miglioramenti per migliorare la visibilità della disponibilità dei materiali.

• Gestire il portafoglio materie prime della supply chain nei sistemi di pianificazione, compreso il controllo del ciclo di vita, e l'esecuzione di aggiornamenti di dati master su larga scala e il monitoraggio degli ordini di pianificazione creati, requisiti di acquisto e ordini di acquisto.

• Resoconto dell'Ordine di acquisto relativo attività a società di revisione esterne.

• Fornire competenze nella gestione di categorie di materiali specializzati.

• Partecipa alle iniziative di sviluppo della supply chain per la gestione dei materiali. Esegui i progetti relativi ai materiali.

• SAP & AFI Key User – riferimento primario per le competenze di sistema e il supporto utente

• Analisi della copertura dei materiali per il sito Visp – definisce i prossimi passi e la futura strategia (progetti supportati da Lonza EC Board Level)

• Core Team Member, ruolo chiave nell'analisi dei processi attuali e nella ristrutturazione della Supply Chain Organization di Visp (MRP & MPL)

• Responsabile per (SMOG) Graffiare i flussi di lavoro approvati. Avviare, tracciare e tracciare – assicurando un livello di inventario accurato e tempestività per i miglioramenti finanziari per tutte e 3 le piattaforme aziendali

• Preparare i rapporti per gli MRP per controllare gli elementi SMOG per la presentazione mensile accurata SMOG.

• Preparazione e presentazione del file mensile per i dipartimenti per verificare la responsabilità SMOG al cliente.

• Core Team Member - Value Stream Mapping Material Management, supporto ottimizzazione e miglioramento dei processi

• Mantenere e analizzare i livelli delle scorte di sicurezza per il sito Visp per garantire una disponibilità ottimale dell'inventario/ Politica di ricostituzione

• Sostenere il Capo della Supply Chain preparando e analizzando più rapporti per il processo decisionale

• Fornire supporto interdipartimentale (QC, Plant Logistics, SC) con report e analisi ad-hoc

• Formazione e onboarding di nuovi dipendenti sull'utilizzo di SAP, assicurando il trasferimento delle conoscenze e l'integrazione più rapida

Cosa stiamo cercando:
· Esperienza di laurea o equivalente in SCM, appalti o qualsiasi campo rilevante
· CPIM, APICS Certificazione sarebbe desiderato
· Min. di 5 anni di esperienza come pianificatore di requisiti materiali o analista
· Esperienza in SCM, Pianificazione dei materiali/Scheduling e/o Acquisti
· Buona conoscenza di SAP, in particolare MM e MS Office (Excel, Powerpoint), PowerBI
· Specialmente la presentazione e le competenze analitiche dei dati sono necessarie.
· Buone capacità di comunicazione e presentazione
· Fluency in inglese è richiesto. Tedesco desiderato
· Forte compagno di squadra e in grado di lavorare tra le squadre interfunzionali

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

La posizione attuale di questa località è a Visp, Svizzera. I candidati ammissibili e le loro famiglie saranno assistiti in movimento, se necessario.

Al sito di Visp, un ufficiale del personale è ricercato per le opere di vigili del fuoco (m/f/d). In questo lavoro impegnativo, sei responsabile della creazione e del monitoraggio della pianificazione operativa presso Protection & Rescue per tutte le aree dello stabilimento Visp. Sono responsabili dei processi e dei documenti associati in caso di incidente e per la formazione preventiva di sicurezza dei dipendenti. In caso di incidente, siete congiuntamente responsabili della gestione degli 80 parenti all'interno di Protection & Rescue.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

Cosa vi aspetta:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa dei benefici locali può essere trovata di seguito:

• Vantaggi in Visp: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

I loro compiti:

• Crea, controlla la pianificazione operativa di tutti gli oggetti rilevanti per gli incidenti e/o per le operazioni della Protezione & Salvataggio importante. Egli è responsabile di tutti i follow-up necessari.

• Controllo delle risorse umane dei vigili del fuoco della milizia per la situazione normale (formazione, supporto tecnico, assistenza) e incidente (evento interno ed esterno a eventi chimici)

• Responsabile per la formazione dei dipendenti nella protezione della respirazione aziendale (maschere protettive, traspiratori ad aria compressa, dispositivi a tubi lunghi).

• Responsabile per la formazione in prevenzione antincendio per tutti i dipendenti del sito.

• Sostegno alla pianificazione e all'attuazione della formazione dei vigili del fuoco e di altre forze.

• Partecipazione allo sviluppo di documenti di formazione, concetti di esercizio e scenari operativi.

• Sviluppa istruzioni di lavoro relative al progetto per tutti i tipi di merci pericolose

• Requisiti per la pianificazione operativa di tutte le missioni possibili

• Responsabilità del progetto indipendente nell'area assegnata di responsabilità.

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Completata la formazione come ufficiale di lotta antincendio e istruttore di fuoco FKS o la volontà di acquisire queste qualifiche.

• Equipaggiamento di salute senza restrizioni per il servizio di fuoco, così come alta resistenza fisica e fitness.

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura.

• Le buone abilità inglesi sono vantaggiose.

• Patente di guida categoria B; idealmente anche categoria C/CE.

• Volontà di lavorare ore flessibili e di partecipare al servizio di piquetting e on-call.

• Forte senso di responsabilità così come un alto grado di indipendenza, affidabilità e integrità.

• Personalità resiliente e decisionale con la capacità di agire in maniera strutturata e sicura anche in situazioni esigenti e critiche.

• Alte competenze sociali, capacità di comunicazione e divertimento di lavorare con partner interni ed esterni.

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, orientato alla soluzione e pragmatico, nonché interesse per lo sviluppo continuo di processi e organizzazioni.

• Luogo di residenza massimo 15 minuti nelle vicinanze della pianta Visp o la volontà di muoversi in una stanza in questo rayon durante il servizio di cottura.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora!

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

At the Visp site, a staff officer is sought for works fire brigade (m/f/d). In this challenging job, you are responsible for creating and tracking the operational planning at Protection & Rescue for all areas of the Visp plant. They are responsible for processes and the associated documents in the event of an incident as well as for the preventive safety training of employees. In the event of an incident, you are jointly responsible for the management of the 80 relatives within Protection & Rescue.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

What awaits you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Our full list of local benefits can be found below:

• Benefits in Visp: https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Their tasks:

• Creates, checks the operational planning for all objects relevant to incidents and/or for operations of the Protection & Rescue important. He is responsible for all necessary follow-ups.

• Securing the human resources of the militia fire brigade for the normal situation (training, technical support, assistance) and incident (internal and external to chemical events)

• Responsible for the training of employees in company breathing protection (protective masks, compressed air breathers, long tube devices).

• Responsible for training in preventive fire protection for all employees at the site.

• Support in the planning and implementation of the training of the fire brigade and other forces.

• Participation in the development of training documents, exercise concepts and operational scenarios.

• Develops project-related work instructions for all types of dangerous goods

• Requirements for operational planning of all possible missions

• Independent project responsibility in the assigned area of responsibility.

Your requirement profile:

• Completed training as a firefighting officer and FKS fire instructor or willingness to acquire these qualifications.

• Unrestricted health suitability for the fire service as well as high physical strength and fitness.

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing.

• Good English skills are beneficial.

• Driving licence category B; ideally additionally category C/CE.

• Willingness to work flexible hours and to participate in the piquetting and on-call service.

• Strong sense of responsibility as well as a high degree of independence, reliability and integrity.

• Resilient, decision-making personality with the ability to act in a structured and secure manner even in demanding and time-critical situations.

• High social skills, communication skills and enjoyment of working with internal and external partners.

• Independent, solution-oriented and pragmatic working method as well as interest in the continuous development of processes and organizations.

• Place of residence maximum 15 minutes in the vicinity of the Visp plant or the willingness to move into a room in this rayon during the cooking service.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

jobs.title: IT Strategic Initiatives Lead
jobs.description:
IT Strategic Initiatives Lead
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Hybrid Working Policy

Reporting to the Group Head of Strategy, Governance & Transformation, the Strategic Initiatives Lead is a highly visible position operating at the heart of the global IT organisation. Acting as a trusted partner to the Group CIO, the role is responsible for driving strategic priorities, supporting executive decision-making, and ensuring effective governance, communication and alignment across the IT function.

Combining elements of strategy, transformation, business management and stakeholder engagement, the Strategic Initiatives Lead will lead high-profile initiatives, develop executive-level reporting and communications, and coordinate key activities across the IT Leadership Team. This role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to influence the direction and delivery of the organisation's technology agenda.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• A variety of benefits tailored to your localality.

• Access to global benefits via https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Partner closely with the Group CIO to drive key priorities, support strategic decision-making, and manage executive-level agendas and activities.

• Develop high-quality presentations, briefing materials, reports and communications for Executive Committee, Board and senior leadership meetings.

• Lead the development and management of IT performance reporting, including KPIs, dashboards and strategic analysis to support business objectives.

• Coordinate IT Leadership Team governance, ensuring effective planning, alignment, accountability and follow-through on key actions and initiatives.

• Oversee and drive the successful execution of strategic programmes and projects across the global IT organisation, including supporting the development of the IT strategy.

• Develop and enhance the IT Training Academy, promoting capability development and learning across the IT function and wider organisation.

• Create and deliver internal and external communication strategies that strengthen engagement, transparency and alignment with key stakeholders.

What we are looking for:

• Experience operating in a Chief of Staff, Strategy, Transformation, Business Management or similar role, partnering with senior technology leaders in a complex global organisation.

• Strong strategic thinking and analytical capability, with experience translating complex information into clear insights, recommendations and executive-level reporting.

• Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with the ability to develop high-impact briefing materials, leadership communications and executive presentations.

• Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, navigate ambiguity and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility and presence to act as a trusted advisor and business partner across global teams.

About Lonza

Relevant du chef du groupe Stratégie, Gouvernance et Transformation, le responsable des initiatives stratégiques est une position très visible au cœur de l'organisation informatique mondiale. • Superviser et diriger l'exécution réussie de programmes et de projets stratégiques dans l'ensemble de l'organisation informatique mondiale, y compris en soutenant l'élaboration de la stratégie informatique.

• Développer et améliorer l'Académie de formation aux technologies de l'information, en favorisant le développement des capacités et l'apprentissage dans l'ensemble de la fonction informatique et de l'organisation.

• Créer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de communication interne et externe qui renforcent l'engagement, la transparence et l'alignement avec les principaux intervenants.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Expérience de travail dans un chef de cabinet, stratégie, transformation, gestion d'entreprise ou un rôle similaire, en partenariat avec des chefs de file technologiques dans une organisation mondiale complexe.

• Forte réflexion stratégique et capacité d'analyse, avec l'expérience de la traduction de l'information complexe en idées claires, recommandations et rapports à l'échelon de la direction.

• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en présentation, avec la capacité d'élaborer des documents d'information à fort impact, des communications de leadership et des présentations de cadres.

• Très organisé avec la capacité de gérer simultanément plusieurs priorités, naviguer l'ambiguïté et produire des résultats dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

• Forte capacité d'établir des relations et de gérer les parties prenantes, avec la crédibilité et la présence d'agir en tant que conseiller de confiance et partenaire d'affaires dans les équipes mondiales.

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. We are seeking a highly motivated Chemist to join our Analytical Development Team for Small Molecules within the Advanced Synthesis Platform. In this role, you will lead analytical development activities for customer projects and take responsibility for the development, validation, and implementation of chromatographic analytical methods supporting the manufacture of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will provide scientific leadership and ensure the delivery of robust analytical solutions throughout the drug development and manufacturing lifecycle.

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed

Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly in Operations, we build production-ready data infrastructure that connects process, execution, and development data into a coherent and trusted foundation used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Operations, and global data teams.

We are looking for a Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence in Visp to design, build, and operate this data foundation and support reliable, scalable use of operational data across teams

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What You Will Do:

• Design, build, and operate automated data pipelines integrating distributed file-based data stores and raw operational system databases, including historians (PI), MES, ELN and instrument data, into a coherent, end-to-end operational data foundation.

• Replace manual, file-based data handling with governed, versioned and traceable data flows that stand up to daily operational use.

• Implement and enforce data quality checks, validation rules and monitoring to ensure data reliability at scale in an operational environment.

• Deliver analytics-ready datasets (clean schemas, consistent semantics, time-aligned data) to downstream BI, advanced analytics and modeling layers supporting operational decision-making.

• Work closely with MSAT, Process Development, Automation, QA, IT and global data teams to align data models, definitions and integration patterns across the organization.

• Continuously improve pipeline performance, robustness and maintainability in line with operational priorities.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience building, operating, and optimizing production-grade data pipelines in manufacturing, industrial, or operational environments.

• Strong SQL expertise with the ability to design efficient data models and optimize queries for high-volume operational workloads.

• Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipeline development and integration of process, execution, and operational data sources.

• Practical knowledge of OT systems, including MES, PI Historian, instrument data, or similar industrial data platforms.

• Solid understanding of data quality, lineage, traceability, governance, and compliance, ideally within GxP-regulated environments.

• Experience with Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage, Git-based version control, and cloud-native data architectures.

• Background in biopharma, life sciences, manufacturing, or operations data, with the ability to translate complex operational processes into scalable data solutions.

About Lonza:
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è che i dipendenti di talento lavorano insieme
e sviluppare idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Per il sito Visp stiamo cercando un laboratorio QC (m/f/d)

I loro compiti:

• Attuazione (compresa la gestione dei dispositivi, la preparazione dei campioni, la produzione e il rilascio di soluzioni ed eluenti), la documentazione e la valutazione (CDS Empower) delle analisi (analisi dei batch, studi di stabilità e implementazione dei metodi, trasferimento e convalida) sotto GMP in base alle normative di test nel campo della cromatografia e dell'elettroforesi

• Responsabilità per attrezzature assegnate (compresa la taratura, la qualificazione, l'organizzazione del servizio o la riparazione, nonché la formazione di attrezzature)

• Adattamento delle istruzioni di prova, nonché la creazione di protocolli di analisi e di eluente

• Responsabilità per lavori di laboratorio speciali secondo l'elenco interno delle responsabilità (ad esempio ordini, gestione delle colonne, stoccaggio dei campioni, ecc.)

• Rispetto delle regole di sicurezza e manutenzione della pulizia e dell'ordine in laboratorio (6S)

• Formazione e induzione di nuovi dipendenti o studenti

Il vostro profilo di requisito:

• Hai completato la formazione come assistente di laboratorio: in (m/f/d), specializzazione in chimica o biologia (o una qualifica simile)

• Idealmente, hai esperienza professionale nel controllo della qualità e familiarità con i processi rilevanti in GMP e/o hai conoscenza dell'analisi HPLC

• Sono responsabili, autorifletti e hanno una mentalità aperta, così come buone capacità di comunicazione

• Godono di essere coinvolti in una squadra giovane e grande, sono impegnati ed empatici

• Hai imparato la lingua tedesca e inglese su un livello negoziato

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo dà loro certezza e
Soddisfazione, davvero fare la differenza con il proprio lavoro.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees working together
and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

For the Visp site we are looking for a QC laboratory (m/f/d)

Their tasks:

• Implementation (including device handling, sample preparation, production and release of solutions and eluents), documentation and evaluation (CDS Empower) of analyses (batch analysis, stability studies as well as method implementation, transfer and validation) under GMP based on test regulations in the field of chromatography and electrophoresis

• Responsibility for assigned equipment (including calibration, qualification, organisation of the service or repair, as well as equipment training)

• Adaptation of test instructions, as well as the creation of analysis and eluent protocols

• Responsibility for special laboratory work according to internal list of responsibilities (e.g. orders, column management, sample storage, etc.)

• Compliance with safety rules and maintenance of cleanliness and order in the laboratory (6S)

• Training and induction of new employees or learners

Your requirement profile:

• You have completed training as a laboratory assistant: in (m/f/d), specialisation in chemistry or biology (or a similar qualification)

• Ideally, you have professional experience in quality control and are familiar with the relevant processes under GMP and/or have knowledge of HPLC analysis

• They are responsible, self-reflected and have an open mindset, as well as good communication skills

• They enjoy getting involved in a young and large team, are committed and empathetic

• You have mastered the German and English language on a negotiated level

Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important to us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a priority and we protect both our employees and our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges and use their creativity to develop new ideas for complex problems. Together we make a contribution that can improve the lives of many people around the world. This gives them certainty and
Satisfaction, really making a difference with your own work.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten
und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für den Standort Visp suchen wir eine(n) QC Laborant (m/w/d)

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Durchführung (inkl. Gerätehandhabung, Probenvorbereitung, Herstellung und Freigabe von Lösungen und Eluenten), Dokumentation und Auswertung (CDS Empower) von Analysen (Batchanalytik, Stabilitätsstudien sowie Methodenimplementierung, -transfer und -validierungen) unter GMP anhand Prüfvorschriften im Bereich Chromatographie und Elektrophorese

• Verantwortung für zugeteilte Geräte (inkl. Kalibrierung, Qualifizierung, Organisation des Services oder Reparatur, sowie Geräteschulungen)

• Anpassen von Prüfanweisungen, sowie die Erstellung von Analysen- und Eluenten-Protokollen

• Verantwortung für spezielle Laborarbeiten gemäss interner Zuständigkeitsliste (z.B. Bestellungen, Säulenmanagement, Probenlagerung, etc.)

• Einhaltung von Sicherheitsregeln und Aufrechterhaltung von Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor (6S)

• Schulung und Einarbeitung von neuen Mitarbeitenden oder Lernenden

Ihre Anforderungsprofil:

• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant:in (m/w/d), Fachrichtung Chemie oder Biologie (oder eine ähnliche Qualifikation)

• Sie haben idealerweise Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Qualitätskontrolle und sind vertraut mit den entsprechenden Prozessen unter GMP und/oder besitzen Kenntnisse in der HPLC-Analytik

• Sie sind verantwortungsbewusst, selbstreflektiert und besitzen ein offenes Mindset, sowie gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Sie haben Spass daran, sich in ein junges und grosses Team einzubringen, sind engagiert und empathisch

• Sie beherrschen die deutsche und englische Sprache auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen, ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die
Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.
