titleByLocale.fr: Chef de groupe Développement-MSAT Drug Linker 80-100%

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp, the Group Leader Development / MSAT Drug Linker-Toxin will lead the assigned Process Development and/or MSAT chemists working on pipeline development and portfolio optimization of Drug Linker-Toxin products.
You will ensure close alignment between your team and the supported production facilities, while collaborating with the ADS Portfolio Optimization and Pipeline Development organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for the roadmap and strategy for continuous improvement, technical capabilities, and capacity of the assigned Development & MSAT scientist team.
This is a highly visible role for a scientist who wants to combine deep technical expertise with people leadership, customer-facing scientific impact, and strategic contribution to a growing ADC manufacturing organization.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead, coordinate, execute, control, and monitor the performance of assigned Drug Linker-Toxin Process Development and/or MSAT chemists in line with agreed objectives and commitments.

• Support the responsible Drug Linker Organization Head, in alignment with the Lab Team Group Leader and lab production managers, in managing and allocating required chemist resources.

• Guide Development and/or MSAT chemists to enable efficient, robust transfer of Drug Linker-Toxin production processes into supported GMP manufacturing facilities.

• Drive the development and implementation of innovative technologies to increase capability, capacity, and efficiency within Drug Linker-Toxin operations.

• Act as a technical and scientific expert for Drug Linker-Toxin projects internally and externally, including creation of external scientific content to enhance reputation and visibility.

• Facilitate the exchange of best practices in Drug Linker-Toxin projects and containment technology across teams and functions.

• Lead all HR-related aspects for the assigned team and actively contribute to the scientific development of scientists in their areas of expertise.

• Ensure compliance with GMP and safety regulations throughout all activities.

• Support the Head of Drug Linker Organization in assigned initiatives and strategic duties.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; PhD in Organic Chemistry preferred.

• Approximately 5-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical process development, API development, clinical supply, or manufacturing sciences.

• Proven experience leading complex projects in a matrix organization within clinical supply, development, or manufacturing operations.

• Strong knowledge of chemical process development, scale-up, technology transfer, and GMP manufacturing requirements.

• Good knowledge of Drug Linker-Toxin technology and understanding of safe work execution in containment assets.

• People management experience or strong motivation to develop into an expanded leadership role, including coaching and talent development.

• Demonstrated experience managing project budgets and delivering against performance targets.

• Fluent English language skills; German proficiency is a strong asset.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Con sede a Visp, il Gruppo Leader Development / MSAT Drug Linker-Toxin porterà gli esperti di sviluppo del processo e/o MSAT che lavorano sullo sviluppo delle tubazioni e l'ottimizzazione del portafoglio dei prodotti Drug Linker-Toxin.
Potrai garantire un allineamento stretto tra il tuo team e gli impianti di produzione supportati, collaborando con le organizzazioni ADS Portfolio Optimization e Pipeline Development. In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili della roadmap e della strategia per il miglioramento continuo, le capacità tecniche e la capacità del team di scienziati assegnato Development & MSAT.
Questo è un ruolo altamente visibile per uno scienziato che vuole combinare profonda competenza tecnica con la leadership delle persone, l'impatto scientifico di fronte al cliente, e il contributo strategico per una crescente organizzazione di produzione ADC.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione.

L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Cosa farai:

• Guidare, coordinare, eseguire, controllare e monitorare le prestazioni degli esperti di Drug Linker-Toxin Process Development e/o MSAT in linea con gli obiettivi e gli impegni concordati.

• Sostenere il responsabile Drug Linker Organization Head, in allineamento con il Lab Team Group Leader e i responsabili della produzione di laboratorio, nella gestione e nell'assegnazione delle risorse chimiche richieste.

• Guida Sviluppo e/o chimici MSAT per consentire un trasferimento efficiente e robusto dei processi di produzione di Drug Linker-Toxin in impianti di produzione GMP supportati.

• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di tecnologie innovative per aumentare la capacità, la capacità e l'efficienza nelle operazioni di Drug Linker-Toxin.

• Agire come esperto tecnico e scientifico per i progetti Drug Linker-Toxin internamente ed esternamente, compresa la creazione di contenuti scientifici esterni per migliorare la reputazione e la visibilità.

• Facilita lo scambio delle migliori pratiche nei progetti di Drug Linker-Toxin e nella tecnologia di contenimento tra team e funzioni.

• Guidare tutti gli aspetti legati alle risorse umane per il team assegnato e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo scientifico degli scienziati nelle loro aree di competenza.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle normative GMP e di sicurezza in tutte le attività.

• Sostenere il Capo dell'Organizzazione dei Linker della Droga in iniziative assegnate e compiti strategici.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• PhD in Chimica, Ingegneria Chimica, o una disciplina relativa; PhD in Chimica Organica ha preferito.

• Circa 5-10 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del processo farmaceutico, nello sviluppo API, nella fornitura clinica o nelle scienze della produzione.

• Esperienza comprovata che conduce progetti complessi in un'organizzazione di matrice all'interno di attività di fornitura clinica, sviluppo o produzione.

• Forte conoscenza di processi chimici sviluppo, scala-up, trasferimento tecnologico e requisiti di produzione GMP.

• Buona conoscenza della tecnologia Drug Linker-Toxin e comprensione dell'esecuzione di lavoro sicura nei beni di contenimento.

• Esperienza di gestione delle persone o forte motivazione per sviluppare un ruolo di leadership ampliato, tra cui coaching e sviluppo del talento.

• Dimostrata esperienza di gestione dei bilanci di progetto e la consegna contro gli obiettivi di performance.

• competenze linguistiche fluenti; la competenza tedesca è un bene forte.

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Mit Sitz in Visp wird der Group Leader Development / MSAT Drug Linker-Toxin die beauftragten Prozessentwicklungs- und / oder MSAT-Chemiker leiten, die an der Pipeline-Entwicklung und Portfoliooptimierung von Drug Linker-Toxin-Produkten arbeiten.

Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare Rolle für einen Wissenschaftler, der tiefes technisches Fachwissen mit Menschenführung, kundenorientierten wissenschaftlichen Auswirkungen und strategischem Beitrag zu einer wachsenden ADC-Fertigungsorganisation kombinieren möchte.

Dies ist eine vollständig ortsbezogene Rolle. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die erforderlich ist, um Arzneimittel nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards herzustellen.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Rolle und Standort.

Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Was Sie tun werden:

• Führen, koordinieren, ausführen, kontrollieren und überwachen Sie die Leistung der zugewiesenen Drug Linker-Toxin-Prozessentwicklung und / oder MSAT-Chemiker im Einklang mit den vereinbarten Zielen und Verpflichtungen.

• Unterstützen Sie den verantwortlichen Leiter der Drug Linker Organization in Abstimmung mit dem Lab Team Group Leader und den Laborproduktionsleitern bei der Verwaltung und Zuweisung der erforderlichen Chemikerressourcen.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la feuille de route et de la stratégie pour l'amélioration continue, les capacités techniques et la capacité de l'équipe scientifique de développement et MSAT assignée.
Il s'agit d'un rôle très visible pour un scientifique qui veut combiner une expertise technique profonde avec le leadership humain, l'impact scientifique de la clientèle et la contribution stratégique à une organisation manufacturière ADC en croissance.

C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement.

Ce que vous ferez :

• Diriger, coordonner, exécuter, contrôler et surveiller le rendement des chimistes chargés de la mise au point des procédés de liaison entre les médicaments et les toxines et/ou du MSAT conformément aux objectifs et aux engagements convenus.

• Appuyer le chef de l'organisation responsable de l'établissement de liens avec les médicaments, en accord avec le chef du groupe d'équipe de laboratoire et les gestionnaires de la production de laboratoire, dans la gestion et l'affectation des ressources chimistes requises.

• Agir en tant qu'expert technique et scientifique pour les projets de liaison médicamenteuse-toxine à l'interne et à l'externe, y compris la création de contenu scientifique externe pour améliorer la réputation et la visibilité.

• Faciliter l'échange de pratiques exemplaires dans les projets de liaison médicamenteuse-toxine et la technologie de confinement entre les équipes et les fonctions.

• Diriger tous les aspects liés aux RH pour l'équipe assignée et contribuer activement au développement scientifique des scientifiques dans leurs domaines d'expertise.

• Assurer la conformité aux BPF et aux règlements de sécurité tout au long de toutes les activités.

• Appuyer le chef de l'organisation de liaison des drogues dans les initiatives et les tâches stratégiques assignées.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• PhD en chimie, génie chimique ou une discipline connexe; PhD en chimie organique préféré.

• Environ 5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans le développement de procédés pharmaceutiques, le développement d'API, l'approvisionnement clinique ou les sciences de la fabrication.

• Expérience éprouvée menant des projets complexes dans une organisation matricielle au sein d'opérations cliniques d'approvisionnement, de développement ou de fabrication.

• Bonne connaissance des exigences en matière de développement des procédés chimiques, d'expansion, de transfert de technologie et de fabrication de BPF.

• Bonne connaissance de la technologie de liaison médicamenteuse-toxine et compréhension de l'exécution sécuritaire des travaux dans les installations de confinement.

• Expérience en gestion des personnes ou forte motivation à devenir un rôle de leadership élargi, y compris l'encadrement et le perfectionnement des talents.

• Expérience démontrée de la gestion des budgets des projets et de la réalisation des objectifs de rendement.

• Compétences linguistiques en anglais; la compétence en allemand est un atout important.

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Lead a highly engaged team of operators and line mechanics on a vial filling & lyophilisation line, where your voice matters, decisions are made together, and you can truly shape how the operation runs. In this hands-on leadership role, you'll balance coaching an autonomous team with  stakeholder management across Engineering, Supply Chain, MSAT, and Quality in a fast-paced and dynamic GMP environment. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits
The list of local benefits: 3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5

What you will do:

• Lead and inspire a high-performing team of operators and line mechanics, providing coaching and support while empowering individuals to take ownership and make decisions in a highly autonomous environment.

• Drive the safe, compliant, and efficient execution of vial filling and lyophilisation operations, ensuring production targets and clinical supply commitments are met while maintaining GMP excellence.

• Partner closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, MSAT, Quality, and other stakeholders to align priorities, solve challenges, and ensure seamless manufacturing operations.

• Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence, supporting deviation management, investigations, root cause analysis, and the implementation of sustainable process improvements.

• Balance a visible presence on the manufacturing floor with strategic planning responsibilities, helping the team navigate a fast-paced, dynamic environment while fostering a culture of safety, accountability, and collaboration.

What we are looking for:

• Experience in GMP-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing is essential, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced production environment and confidently balance operational priorities.

• Strong people and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative, approachable leadership style and the ability to build effective partnerships across Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, MSAT, and Supply Chain.

• Fluent German is required; English skills are considered an advantage.

• Leadership experience in a manufacturing environment is highly valued; however, candidates with strong hands-on aseptic fill & finish expertise looking to take the next step into leadership are equally encouraged to apply.

• Experience with aseptic fill & finish operations, particularly vials and lyophilisation processes, is a strong advantage, while a scientific degree is beneficial but not required.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Manufacturing DSP
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our growing Ibex™ Solutions team in Visp and play a key leadership role in advancing innovative biologics manufacturing. As Associate Director, Manufacturing Downstream Processing (DSP), you will lead a high-performing operational team, drive manufacturing excellence, and contribute to the successful delivery of life-changing therapies for our customers and patients worldwide.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• The opportunity to lead a highly skilled, multidisciplinary manufacturing team within a growing biologics manufacturing environment.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace where collaboration and innovation are encouraged.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance and leadership impact.

• Professional development opportunities across a global life sciences organization.

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of process engineers, specialists, and manufacturing professionals, fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Take ownership of operational performance within the DSP manufacturing area, ensuring production readiness, execution, and reliable on-time delivery.

• Drive the resolution of manufacturing challenges and complex production issues in close collaboration with MSAT, Production Support, QA, and Upstream Processing teams.

• Provide leadership for risk assessments, workplace inspections, technical change management, and compliance activities within the manufacturing unit.

• Represent the DSP organization during customer interactions, audits, and regulatory inspections, serving as a trusted operational expert.

• Contribute to capital investment projects, including facility design, equipment implementation, startup, and commissioning activities.

• As a member of the Production Leadership Team, champion operational excellence, innovation, employee development, and continuous improvement initiatives across the production organization.

What we are looking for

• Experience leading teams and operations within a GMP-regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

• Strong expertise in downstream processing and biologics manufacturing, with knowledge of mammalian cell culture processes.

• Demonstrated ability to build, develop, coach, and engage high-performing technical teams.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with experience managing complex manufacturing or production challenges.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions and communicate confidently with customers, leadership teams, and regulatory inspectors.

• Degree in Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Strong English communication skills, with German an advantage, combined with a structured mindset, initiative, and a team-oriented approach.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Forte capacità di problem solving e decision-making, con esperienza di gestione complesse sfide di produzione o di produzione.

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti i background portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

jobs.description:
Der Arbeitsort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Anspruchsberechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Der Produktionsbetrieb Accelerate in Visp ist gestartet – und wir suchen dich, um ihn gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.
Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Werde Teil eines motivierten Teams und bring dein Know-how in einer modernen Produktionsanlage zum Einsatz.

Diese Stelle erfordert eine durchgehende Präsenz vor Ort. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht eine enge, zeitnahe Zusammenarbeit und die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was wir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie unten:

• Benefits in Visp

Deine Aufgaben:

• Selbstständige Durchführung, Überwachung und Dokumentation von Produktionsprozessen und Anlagenrundgängen nach GMP‑Vorgaben

• Sicheres Arbeiten unter Einhaltung aller Sicherheits‑, Qualitäts‑ und Betriebsrichtlinien (GMP)

• Aktive Mitarbeit im 4‑Schicht‑Betrieb sowie flexible Übernahme von Spezialaufträgen

• Verantwortung für Ordnung und Sauberkeit am Arbeitsplatz

• Einbringen deiner beruflichen Erfahrung sowie Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen

Was wir suchen:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, technisches oder handwerkliches Verständnis, IT‑Grundkenntnisse (MS Office)

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Teamgeist, Genauigkeit, hohes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und körperliche Belastbarkeit

• Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Belastbarkeit und Teamfähigkeit

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit im 4-Schicht-Betrieb

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Jede Idee, ob groß oder klein und von welcher Person sie auch kommt, hat das Potenzial, das Leben von Millionen Menschen zu verbessern, und genau an dieser Art von Arbeit möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie in unserem Team begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il luogo di lavoro di questo ufficio è a Visp, in Svizzera. I candidati ammissibili e le loro famiglie saranno assistiti in movimento, se necessario.

L'impianto di produzione Accelerate di Visp è iniziato – e stiamo cercando di svilupparlo insieme.
Allora hai ragione con noi. Diventa parte di un team motivato e usa il tuo know-how in un moderno stabilimento di produzione.

Questo corpo richiede una presenza continua in loco. La collaborazione personale consente una stretta collaborazione tempestiva e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la produzione di medicinali ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Una varietà di vantaggi, a seconda della funzione e della posizione

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa dei benefici locali può essere trovata di seguito:

• Vantaggi in Visp

I vostri compiti:

• Attuazione indipendente, monitoraggio e documentazione dei processi produttivi e dei tour degli impianti secondo le specifiche GMP

• Lavoro sicuro nel rispetto di tutte le linee guida di sicurezza, qualità e funzionamento (GMP)

• Partecipazione attiva alle operazioni a 4 turni e acquisizione flessibile di ordini speciali

• Responsabilità per ordine e pulizia sul posto di lavoro

• Contribuisci la tua esperienza professionale e il supporto per l'induzione di nuovi colleghi:

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Formazione professionale completa, tecnica o artigianale, conoscenze informatiche di base (MS Office)

• Conoscenza molto buona di tedesco, spirito di squadra, accuratezza, elevata consapevolezza della sicurezza e resilienza fisica

• Alto senso di responsabilità, resistenza e lavoro di squadra

• Prontezza per il lavoro a turni nel funzionamento a 4 turni

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Ogni idea, grande o piccola e da qualsiasi persona che viene, ha il potenziale per migliorare la vita di milioni di persone, e questo è esattamente il tipo di lavoro a cui vogliamo che partecipiate.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie pratiche, non vediamo l'ora di darvi il benvenuto al nostro team.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora!

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland. Eligible applicants and their families will be assisted in moving if needed.

The Accelerate production facility in Visp has started – and we are looking for you to develop it together.
Then you are exactly right with us. Become part of a motivated team and use your know-how in a modern production plant.

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Our full list of local benefits can be found below:

• Benefits in Visp

Your tasks:

• Independent implementation, monitoring and documentation of production processes and plant tours according to GMP specifications

• Safe working in compliance with all safety, quality and operating guidelines (GMP)

• Active participation in 4-shift operations and flexible takeover of special orders

• Responsibility for order and cleanliness in the workplace

• Contribute your professional experience as well as support for the induction of new colleagues:

What we are looking for:

• Completed vocational training, technical or craftsmanship, basic IT knowledge (MS Office)

• Very good knowledge of German, team spirit, accuracy, high security awareness and physical resilience

• High sense of responsibility, resilience and teamwork

• Readiness for shift work in 4-shift operation

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of collaboration, responsibility, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Every idea, big or small and from whichever person it comes, has the potential to improve the lives of millions of people, and this is exactly the kind of work we want you to participate in.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate the groundbreaking ideas of our customers into practical therapies, we look forward to welcoming you to our team.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

Le lieu de travail de ce bureau est à Viège, Suisse. Les demandeurs admissibles et leurs familles seront aidés à déménager au besoin.

L'usine de production accélérée de Viège a démarré – et nous sommes à la recherche de vous pour le développer ensemble.
Alors vous avez raison avec nous. Faites partie d'une équipe motivée et utilisez votre savoir-faire dans une usine de production moderne.

Ce corps nécessite une présence continue sur place. La collaboration personnelle permet une coopération étroite et opportune et la précision technique requise pour la production de médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé

• Avantages en Viège

• Mise en œuvre indépendante, suivi et documentation des processus de production et des visites d'usine selon les spécifications des BPF

• Travailler en toute sécurité conformément à toutes les directives de sécurité, de qualité et d'exploitation (BPF)

• Participation active à des opérations de 4 équipes et reprise flexible des commandes spéciales

• Responsabilité de l'ordre et de la propreté sur le lieu de travail

• Contribuez à votre expérience professionnelle ainsi qu'à votre soutien à l'initiation de nouveaux collègues :

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Formation professionnelle complète, technique ou artisanal, connaissances informatiques de base (MS Office)

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand, esprit d'équipe, précision, haute sécurité et résilience physique

• Un sens élevé des responsabilités, de la résilience et du travail d'équipe

• Préparation au travail posté en 4 équipes

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilité, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Chaque idée, grande ou petite, et de qui qu'elle vienne, a le potentiel d'améliorer la vie de millions de personnes, et c'est exactement le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de différents horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à traduire les idées révolutionnaires de nos clients en thérapies pratiques, nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir à notre équipe.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Présentez-vous !

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Tower, Switzerland.

We are looking for a Legal Counsel to support our Licensing Business. The role will focus on partnering with a dynamic and growing business in the evaluation, development and commercialization of innovative technologies. The successful candidate will review, draft, and negotiate a variety of contracts, including confidentiality agreements, material transfer agreements, research and evaluation agreements, supply agreements and research collaboration agreements, and where applicable, licensing and other strategic commercial agreements.

As a key legal partner to the business, you will support technology focused projects from early-stage collaborations through commercialization activities. You will provide pragmatic legal advice on commercial, operational and strategic matters, working closely with R&D, Business Development, Manufacturing, Intellectual Property (IP) and other cross functional teams to help advance innovative technologies and support customer programs. Additionally, you will support the implementation of AI tools for the legal function and contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of contract templates.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• Opportunity to work at the intersection of scientific innovation, technology commercialization and strategic business growth, partnering closely with a passionate and rapidly expanding business team

What you will do:

• Contract Negotiation & Drafting: Review, draft, and negotiate a variety of commercial and research related contracts, including confidentiality agreements, material transfer agreements, supply agreement, research collaboration agreements and license agreements, ensuring alignment with business goals and regulatory frameworks

• Legal Advisory: Provide legal guidance on commercial, operational, and technology-related matters, balancing legal risk with business objectives in a fast-paced environment

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with IP, R&D, Business Development, and Manufacturing teams to support innovation projects, strategic collaborations and technology commercialization initiatives

• Help with implementing AI-driven legal tools to improve contract management and legal workflows.

• Update and improve standard agreements to reflect industry standards in the CDMO and pharmaceutical sectors.

What we are looking for:

• Law degree with 3-5 years of experience, preferably in a law firm and as in-house lawyer in a CDMO, pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences environment

• Strong contract drafting and negotiation skills across commercial, research, collaboration, supply and technology-related agreements. Experience with licensing transactions is desirable but not required

• Ability to work cross-functionally and align legal strategies with business and regulatory needs

• Curiosity and willingness to understand the scientific, commercial, and strategic context behind innovative technologies and business initiatives

• Initiative in streamlining contract processes and improving templates, playbooks and other tools supporting operational and research activities

• Eagerness to learn about emerging technologies, scientific developments, business models, and industry trends within the life sciences sector

• Strong communication skills to build trust and act as a collaborative legal partner across departments

• Curiosity about demonstrating legal tech tools to improve contract lifecycle management and partners collaboration

• Good knowledge of written and spoken English, German is a plus

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un conseiller juridique pour soutenir notre entreprise de licence. Le rôle sera axé sur le partenariat avec une entreprise dynamique et en croissance dans l'évaluation, le développement et la commercialisation de technologies innovantes. Le candidat retenu examinera, rédigera et négociera divers contrats, notamment des accords de confidentialité, des accords de transfert de matériel, des accords de recherche et d'évaluation, des accords de fourniture et des accords de collaboration en recherche, et, le cas échéant, des accords de licence et d'autres accords commerciaux stratégiques.

En tant que partenaire juridique clé de l'entreprise, vous soutiendrez des projets axés sur la technologie depuis les premières étapes de la collaboration jusqu'aux activités de commercialisation. Vous fournirez des conseils juridiques pragmatiques sur des questions commerciales, opérationnelles et stratégiques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec la R-D, le développement des entreprises, la fabrication, la propriété intellectuelle (PI) et d'autres équipes interfonctionnelles pour aider à faire progresser les technologies novatrices et soutenir les programmes à la clientèle. De plus, vous soutiendrez la mise en œuvre d'outils d'IA pour la fonction juridique et contribuerez à l'élaboration et au perfectionnement continus de modèles de contrats.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé

• Possibilité de travailler à l'intersection de l'innovation scientifique, de la commercialisation de la technologie et de la croissance stratégique des entreprises, en partenariat étroit avec une équipe d'affaires passionnée et en pleine expansion

Ce que vous ferez :

• Négociation et rédaction de contrats : Examiner, rédiger et négocier divers contrats commerciaux et liés à la recherche, y compris les accords de confidentialité, les accords de transfert de matériel, les accords d'approvisionnement, les accords de collaboration en recherche et les accords de licence, en veillant à l'harmonisation avec les objectifs commerciaux et les cadres réglementaires

• Conseil juridique : Fournir des conseils juridiques sur les questions commerciales, opérationnelles et technologiques, en conciliant les risques juridiques et les objectifs commerciaux dans un environnement rapide

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de la PI, de la R-D, du développement des entreprises et de la fabrication pour appuyer les projets d'innovation, les collaborations stratégiques et les initiatives de commercialisation de la technologie

• Aider à mettre en œuvre des outils juridiques axés sur l'IA pour améliorer la gestion des contrats et les flux de travail juridiques.

• Mettre à jour et améliorer les ententes types afin de tenir compte des normes de l'industrie dans les secteurs de l'OCVM et des produits pharmaceutiques.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Diplôme de droit de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans un cabinet d'avocats et comme avocat interne dans un environnement CDMO, pharmaceutique, biotech ou sciences de la vie

• De solides compétences en rédaction et en négociation de contrats dans les accords commerciaux, de recherche, de collaboration, d'approvisionnement et de technologie. L'expérience des opérations de licence est souhaitable mais n'est pas requise.

• Capacité de travailler de façon interfonctionnelle et d'aligner les stratégies juridiques sur les besoins opérationnels et réglementaires

• Curiosité et volonté de comprendre le contexte scientifique, commercial et stratégique derrière les technologies innovantes et les initiatives commerciales

• Initiative visant à rationaliser les processus contractuels et à améliorer les modèles, les livres de lecture et autres outils appuyant les activités opérationnelles et de recherche

• Agrément à apprendre sur les technologies émergentes, les développements scientifiques, les modèles d'affaires et les tendances de l'industrie dans le secteur des sciences de la vie

• Fortes compétences en communication pour établir la confiance et agir en tant que partenaire juridique collaboratif dans l'ensemble des ministères

• Curiosité de démontrer des outils de technologie juridique pour améliorer la gestion du cycle de vie des contrats et la collaboration des partenaires

• Bonne connaissance de l'anglais écrit et parlé, l'allemand est un plus

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

In this role, you will develop and execute growth strategies that increase revenue, expand product portfolios, and deliver against sales and margin targets. • Build and maintain detailed knowledge of customer sourcing, supply chain, and procurement strategies to identify growth opportunities and influence buying decisions.

Ubicazione: Regno Unito o Svizzera
Viaggi: fino al 50%
Modello di lavoro: Completamente remoto

Il ruolo:
Stiamo cercando un manager, sviluppo aziendale, conti di crescita per guidare la crescita dei ricavi attraverso il nostro portafoglio clienti Tier 1. Lavorando a stretto contatto con Gestione account Crescita (GAM) e Gestione account Piattaforma, si identificano nuove opportunità di prodotto, espandere l'adozione del prodotto e rafforzare le relazioni all'interno di account strategici chiave.

In questo ruolo, svilupperai ed eseguirai strategie di crescita che aumentano i ricavi, espandono i portafogli dei prodotti, e consegneranno contro gli obiettivi di vendita e di margine. Utilizzando un approccio consultivo, lavorerai con i team interni e gli stakeholder senior del cliente per scoprire opportunità, creare valore e sostenere la crescita del conto a lungo termine.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione

• L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile anche su https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Cosa farai:

• Guidare l'acquisizione di nuovi prodotti e l'espansione del portafoglio all'interno dei clienti Major Accounts e Tier 1, identificare le opportunità per aumentare i ricavi e rafforzare le partnership strategiche.

• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dei prodotti, delle tecnologie, delle capacità produttive e degli obiettivi aziendali per anticipare efficacemente le esigenze e allineare le soluzioni.

• Costruire e mantenere la conoscenza dettagliata di approvvigionamento, catena di approvvigionamento e strategie di approvvigionamento per identificare le opportunità di crescita e influenzare le decisioni di acquisto.

• Navigare organizzazioni clienti complesse, comprendere le parti interessate chiave, processi decisionali e requisiti RFI/RFP per posizionare con successo soluzioni e garantire nuove imprese.

• Condurre discussioni commerciali e negoziare accordi reciprocamente vantaggiosi, collaborando con i team interni per convertire le opportunità in nuovi prodotti vince.

• Agire come collegamento tra i clienti e le parti interessate interne, tra cui le vendite tecniche, lo sviluppo commerciale e i team della piattaforma, garantendo l'allineamento sulle capacità, le proposizioni di valore e i requisiti del cliente.

• Rappresentare il business in conferenze, fiere e eventi del cliente, sostenendo le attività di lead generation, lo sviluppo di partnership, e la conversione delle prospettive in opportunità qualificate.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea educata in una disciplina di Scienze della Vita come Biochimica, Chimica, Biologia Molecolare, Scienze Farmaceutiche, o un campo correlato.

• Ampia esperienza di sviluppo commerciale e commerciale all'interno dell'industria farmaceutica, biotecnologia o CDMO, con una comprovata capacità di generare e crescere partnership strategiche dei clienti.

• Forte comprensione del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del farmaco, tra cui le fasi precliniche, cliniche, manifatturiere e di commercializzazione, con la capacità di impegnarsi in significative discussioni scientifiche e commerciali.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e creazione di relazioni, con la fiducia di influenzare gli stakeholder che vanno da esperti tecnici a dirigenti senior.

• Gestire le operazioni di vendita e di coinvolgimento dei clienti utilizzando piattaforme CRM, idealmente Salesforce.com.

• Fluente in inglese scritto e parlato; aggiuntivo

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Bioprocess DSP Team in Visp as Bioprocess Engineer for MMM MC1 DSP 80-100% (m/f/d) and be part of a world‑class environment where innovation meets purpose. You’ll play a key role in purifying life‑saving therapies while collaborating with talented experts in a dynamic, high-performance setting. If you’re passionate about biotechnology and want to make a real impact, this is your opportunity.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you’ll do:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• You will be responsible for executing and optimizing downstream purification steps—such as chromatography, virus inactivation, depth filtration, TFF, and filling—to ensure product quality, yield, and compliance with GMP standards.

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from mammalian (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

What we are looking for:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Couple of years working experience in biomanufacturing required

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Potrai svolgere un ruolo chiave nella purificazione delle terapie salvavita, collaborando con esperti di talento in un ambiente dinamico e ad alte prestazioni. Se siete appassionati di biotecnologia e volete avere un impatto reale, questa è la vostra opportunità.

Questo è un ruolo completamente basato sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. Il nostro elenco completo dei vantaggi locali su misura in Visp può essere trovato su https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Cosa farai:

• Assicurarsi che le attività operative per la produzione clinica e/o commerciale siano eseguite in tempo reale e all'interno di determinati standard di sicurezza e qualità

• Agire come il piombo funzionale per la preparazione, l'esecuzione di produzione, la pulizia e il cambiamento nell'area assegnata

• Sarete responsabili dell'esecuzione e dell'ottimizzazione delle fasi di purificazione a valle, come la cromatografia, l'inattivazione dei virus, la filtrazione della profondità, il TFF e il riempimento, per garantire la qualità del prodotto, la resa e la conformità agli standard GMP.

• Responsabile di una o più aree DSP definite (ad esempio guadagno, lucidatura o riempimento) per la purificazione delle proteine terapeutiche da mammifero (Ingegnere di Bioprocesso DSP)

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea magistrale o equivalente esperienza in Biotecnologia, Ingegneria Biochimica, Biochimica o materie Life Science correlate, o titolare di Bachelor con esperienza nella produzione di farmaci

• Conoscenza in USP (come i bioreattori) o unità DSP (come la cromatografia)

• Un paio di anni di esperienza lavorativa nella biomanufacturing richiesto

• Esperienza GMP e comprensione della tecnologia del bioprocesso

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese, buone competenze tedesche di vantaggio

Informazioni su Lonza:

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
Join Lonza's growing Biologics organization in Visp and play a key role in ensuring the highest standards of equipment cleaning and contamination control for innovative bioconjugate manufacturing processes. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the production of life-changing therapies while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• Conduct cleaning risk assessments for new and existing products, implementing appropriate controls to ensure product quality and patient safety.

• Support GMP manufacturing operations through expert oversight of equipment cleaning processes, investigation activities, and issue resolution.

• Prepare, review, and maintain production documentation, electronic batch records, deviations, change controls, and CAPAs related to cleaning activities.

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement projects and provide training and coaching to operators on cleaning-related procedures, including swabbing and visual inspection activities.

• Degree in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD).

• Experience in biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, particularly in upstream or downstream processing.

• Understanding of equipment cleaning, cleaning validation, contamination control, or related process engineering activities.

• Knowledge of GMP requirements, quality systems, and manufacturing documentation practices.

• Familiarity with USP/DSP equipment and process equipment design within biotechnology production environments.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions and stakeholders.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Tower, Switzerland. Flexible in other locations as well (Stein, Visp, Belgium, Denmark, France, Italy, Ireland, Germany, Hungary, Netherlands, Sweden, Spain, UK, US)

The PMO Strategy Process Director leads the Integrated Biologics strategic planning process, ensuring alignment between business strategy, capital allocation, portfolio priorities, and execution. As a trusted advisor to senior leadership, the role drives strategic decision-making, governance, and performance management to support long-term growth and value creation.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead the end-to-end strategic planning process, including long-range planning, annual strategy cycles, prioritization, and execution alignment.

• Partner with executive leadership to shape strategic priorities, evaluate growth opportunities, and support key business decisions.

• Develop data-driven insights through market analysis, competitive intelligence, financial modeling, and scenario planning.

• Establish and manage governance frameworks that connect strategic objectives, KPIs, and business performance.

• Monitor strategic progress, identify risks and opportunities, and drive corrective actions where needed.

• Oversee capital allocation and portfolio prioritization processes, ensuring investments align with strategic and financial objectives.

• Review and challenge business cases and investment proposals to ensure robust strategic and financial rationale.

• Facilitate cross-functional alignment across sites, functions, and leadership teams.

• Lead the preparation of executive presentations, strategic roadmaps, and key planning documentation.

• Drive continuous improvement, digitalization, and adoption of best practices across strategy and planning processes.

What we are looking for:

• Master's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Business, Strategy, or a related field

• Extensive experience in strategic planning, PMO leadership, consulting, or the biopharmaceutical industry

• Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading business transformation initiatives

• Experience in portfolio management, capital investment planning, and strategic decision-making

• Strong expertise in strategy development, portfolio optimization, and capital allocation, including strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

• Advanced analytical and financial modeling capabilities

• Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, ability to influence and lead without direct authority in a complex global environment

• Good knowledge of written and spoken English

The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland. This is a one year temporary contract.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

As a Scope Change Coordinator (Drug Product Services), you will work in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment, partnering with technical teams, program management, commercial development, finance, legal , and supply chain functions. In this role, you will coordinate project scope changes, support commercial and operational processes, and help ensure successful project execution while maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

What you will do:

• Coordinate amendments and scope changes for ongoing projects in accordance with established processes and governance requirements.

• Collaborate proactively with stakeholders across multiple functions to support project delivery and customer expectations.

• Monitor project performance, including profitability, cost control, pricing, purchase order management, and production forecast updates.

• Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to program execution and project performance.

• Support the maintenance and improvement of processes, contract templates, resource planning tools, and stakeholder information flows.

• Contribute to effective communication and collaboration between customers, project teams, and business functions.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

What we are looking for:

• Experience working in a project coordination, commercial, operational, or business support environment with life sciences background.

• Commercial and financial awareness, with an understanding of project costs, risks, and business impact.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with Power BI, Microsoft Lists, and Power Automate is an advantage.

• English fluent

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at different levels.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple activities while meeting deadlines.

• Ability to understand complex processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support simplification initiatives.

• A proactive, detail-oriented, and results-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and urgency.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

• Kommerzielles und finanzielles Bewusstsein, mit einem Verständnis der Projektkosten, Risiken und Geschäftsauswirkungen.

• Kenntnisse mit Microsoft 365-Anwendungen, einschließlich erweiterter Excel, PowerPoint und Word; Erfahrung mit Power BI, Microsoft Lists und Power Automate ist ein Vorteil.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf verschiedenen Ebenen zu interagieren.

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aktivitäten zu priorisieren, während die Fristen eingehalten werden.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Prozesse zu verstehen, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und Vereinfachungsinitiativen zu unterstützen.

• Ein proaktiver, detailorientierter und ergebnisorientierter Ansatz mit einem starken Gefühl der Rechenschaftspflicht und Dringlichkeit.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

• Collaborer de façon proactive avec les intervenants dans le cadre de fonctions multiples pour appuyer l'exécution des projets et les attentes des clients.

• Surveiller la performance du projet, y compris la rentabilité, le contrôle des coûts, les prix, la gestion des commandes et les mises à jour des prévisions de production.

• Suivre et rendre compte des indicateurs de rendement clés liés à l'exécution des programmes et au rendement des projets.

• Appuyer la maintenance et l'amélioration des processus, des modèles de contrats, des outils de planification des ressources et des flux d'information des intervenants.

• Contribuer à une communication et à une collaboration efficaces entre les clients, les équipes de projet et les fonctions commerciales.

• Établir et maintenir de solides relations de travail avec les intervenants internes et externes.

Ce que nous cherchons :

• Expérience de travail dans un environnement de coordination de projet, commercial, opérationnel ou de soutien aux entreprises ayant une formation en sciences de la vie.

• Connaissance commerciale et financière, avec une compréhension des coûts du projet, des risques et de l'impact commercial.

• Compétence avec les applications Microsoft 365, y compris Excel avancé, PowerPoint, et Word; expérience avec Power BI, Microsoft Lists, et Power Automate est un avantage.

• Anglais couramment

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de dialoguer efficacement avec les intervenants à différents niveaux.

• Des compétences organisationnelles solides et la capacité de prioriser plusieurs activités tout en respectant les échéances.

• Capacité de comprendre les processus complexes, d'identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et de soutenir les initiatives de simplification.

• Une approche proactive, axée sur les détails et axée sur les résultats, avec un fort sentiment de responsabilité et d'urgence.

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et ça, c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.
